jobs.description:
Are you a person who enjoys helping others? Are you currently seeking fulfillment in your professional life?  

  

Hope Services is Silicon Valley’s leading provider of services to people with developmental disabilities and mental health needs. We seek candidates who share our inspirations \& aspirations. Selection of staff is made on a competitive basis, and we are committed to promoting diversity, equity, inclusion \& belonging at all levels..
**\>\>\>\>\> 2025 Winner of Mercury News Best in Silicon Valley** **\<\<\<\<\<****\>\>\>\>\> ASPIRE to Excellence CARF Accredited** **\<\<\<\<\<****\>\>\>\>\> 2024 Great Nonprofits Top\-Rated Nonprofit** **\<\<\<\<\<****\>\>\>\>\> Four\-star Charity Navigator** **\<\<\<\<\<****\>\>\>\>\> 2024 Candid Gold Seal of Transparency** **\<\<\<\<\<**  

* **Salary Range: $5,859\.00 \- $6,414\.75 per month commensurate with experience and qualifications**

  



**Purpose:**
Provides resources support and training to staff and clients to facilitate agency, program, and consumer goals. Supervision, hiring and training staff, budgeting and contract fulfillment, and assignments to perform or discharge special projects in areas of responsibility. Ensures maintenance of equipment, ordering of supplies, inventory and quality of service.

**Principle Responsibilities:**
The following responsibilities represent the essential functions of the position. An employee in this classification is responsible for carrying out the following functions:

1\. Assures adequate program staffing through scheduling, recruitment, hiring,
and orientation of direct service, substitute and volunteer staff as assigned.
Provides all aspects of supervision, evaluation, and training of staff.
2\. Acts as a resource for rehabilitation, program development, community
based employment and activities, acts as a liaison between program
services and the community.
3\. Provides oversight of daily operations and services including case
management, communications, and advocacy, assures quality services are
provided in timely manner.
4\. Assures timely communications with persons served, families, care
providers, funding sources, staff, management and community.
5\. Participates in the development and implementation of the Agency planning
effort including departmental budgeting, policies and procedures, and the
implementation of Agency goals.
6\. Oversees accuracy and timeliness of billing, payroll, funding, DOL
compliance, inventories, training records, and various internal and external
reports.
7\. Conducts tours, presentations and client intakes.
8\. Assures compliance with all safety regulations.
9\. In the absence of a manager, if assigned, may act in that capacity.
10\. Provides direct service in program operations as needed to assure adequate
staffing ratios.
11\. Acts as a mandated abuse reporter.
12\. May perform special projects or other duties as assigned to assure the
efficiency of the program.

**Minimum Qualifications**:
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent plus three years of related experience working with people with disabilities in a rehabilitation environment.

**Reports To:** Manager

**Supervisory Responsibility****:** yes

**Required knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

1\. Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, database and spreadsheet
2\. Ability to communicate effectively and provide excellent customer service
3\. Ability to facilitate systems and checks to assure delivery of quality service
and product to internal and external customers
4\. Knowledge of the principles of management, supervision, planning, fiscal
management, fair employment practices, regulations, safety, health and
client rights
5\. Ability to observe, evaluate, document and communicate verbally and in
writing
6\. Knowledge of rehabilitation and program development

 **Environmental Conditions:**
Constant movement around service area, and travel into the community. Time spent sitting, using a computer station, periods of intense concentration, using the telephone, paperwork. Time spent in meetings, travel to various work site locations throughout three counties. Exposure to outdoor weather and environmental conditions.
Positions connected to a production environment are also exposed to times of fast paced activity, loud noise and to dust and airborne particles.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: NOW HIRING: PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**Full\-Time 10AM\-6PM: M\-F\| School\-Year Position \| Competitive Pay \| FORXA Inc.**

Are you a natural leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment? Can you hold high standards while building a strong, supportive team? If you're organized, decisive, and passionate about making a difference for students, we'd love to meet you.

At FORXA Inc., our Enrichment Program Lead oversees high\-quality after\-school enrichment programs while supporting instructors, building relationships with school administration, and ensuring every student has an exceptional experience.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the primary daily point of contact with principals, assistant principals, and management.
* Coordinate and adjust daily program schedules as needed.
* Assign, reassign, and manage instructor placements.
* Address daily staff absences by phone and coordinate coverage.
* Monitor student behavior and implement appropriate interventions.
* Communicate professionally with parents regarding student concerns.
* Conduct regular instructor evaluations and provide coaching and accountability.
* Observe classrooms daily to ensure instructional quality and company standards are met.
* Maintain accurate student enrollment and attendance records.
* Oversee inventory and ensure materials are properly accounted for.
* Lead weekly staff meetings and maintain clear communication with the team.
* Make confident, timely decisions to keep programs running smoothly.

**We're Looking For Someone Who**

* Has a Bachelor's degree or is near completion of one.
* Is highly organized and detail\-oriented—you can organize just about anything, from a simple notebook to a complex spreadsheet.
* Is tech\-savvy and comfortable learning new software and systems.
* Is physically active and able to move quickly throughout multiple classrooms and campuses.
* Is a strong motivator who can inspire a team while maintaining accountability.
* Can confidently enforce policies and company standards when necessary while also supporting and developing staff.
* Understands that students always come first, above personal opinions or agendas.
* Is an exceptional multitasker who performs well under pressure.
* Maintains a professional appearance, wears the company uniform, and models expectations for the team.
* Has a proactive, go\-getter attitude and willingly goes above and beyond.
* Is available throughout the entire school calendar year, including peak operational periods. Vacation requests during high\-demand program periods are not permitted.
* Is prepared to commit to a one\-year employment agreement.

**The Ideal Candidate**

Our Leads do more than teach—they create engaging classrooms, build positive relationships, and help students develop confidence, creativity, and life skills through enrichment programs. You are confident, decisive, and solution\-oriented. You don't wait to be told what needs to be done—you anticipate challenges, communicate effectively, and take action. You know when to be firm, when to coach, and how to maintain a positive team culture without compromising expectations.

If you're ready to lead with purpose and help create outstanding enrichment experiences for students, we encourage you to apply today.

* Spanish \& English (Required)

* Day Shift (Required)

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (After School Leadership Acdemy)
jobs.description:
**Job Title: ASLA Coordinator**

**HOW THIS ROLE SUPPORTS THE MISSION**

EOYDC’s After School Leadership Academy (ASLA) provides resources for K\-5 students to develop in the areas of academics, leadership, and character. Under the direction of the ASLA Manager, the ASLA Coordinator is responsible for coordinating all aspects of the ASLA program. These duties include, but are not limited to, supporting the design of ASLA curriculum, implementing lesson plans, training and managing the ASLA Youth Leader interns, assessing program outcomes, and building/maintaining relationships with participants, families, and partner schools.

**WHAT YOU WILL LEAD**

This role will collaborate across the organization, sometimes as the lead of a project and sometimes as support. The person in this role will be responsible for ensuring the success of the following:

* Development and facilitation of lessons, activities, field trips, and events that are consistent with the mission of the program for students in grades K\-5
* Creation and adjustment of weekly program schedule in consideration of partner school schedules and organization\-wide events
* ASLA student engagement
* Provide instruction based on engaging lesson plans developed to strengthen academic performance, enhance leadership skills, and develop character
* Supervise children and promote safety and respect amongst all participants
* Identify student academic and behavioral strengths and challenges, and work with the ASLA Manager and team to create appropriate plan to address their unique needs
* Work closely with students’ teachers and families to promote academic success
* Provide students with direct support to promote emotional/psychological health and development
* Establish two way communication channels to facilitate ongoing engagement with participants’ parents, guardians, and educators

**WHO YOU WILL WORK CLOSELY WITH**

This role is part of the ASLA Team, which works directly with EOYDC’s K\-5 students. Specifically, the following people will work directly with you to support your work:

* Manager: ASLA Manager
* Your manager will help guide your work and be an advocate for you amongst senior leadership. They will also, with input from the Chief Program Officer, help you set the objectives and vision for the various activities that you will lead.
* Team Members: ASLA Coaches and Youth Leaders
* The Youth Leaders will work directly with the students on a daily basis and will provide you support by leading or supporting the activities that you plan
* The Coaches will support you as an additional layer of accountability for the youth leaders and will also provide support for large events

**WHO \& WHAT YOU WILL SUPPORT**

EOYDC’s collaborative culture means that everyone supports one another in achieving the organization’s goals. These are some of the ways you will support work that is led by others on the team:

* The ASLA Manager in:
* Identifying opportunities for program and process improvement
* Providing Intern and Staff support
* Provide supervision, guidance, resources, and feedback to ASLA Coaches and Youth Leaders
* Assist with the regular training ASLA Youth Leaders receiving in order to facilitate growth in the areas of classroom management, tutoring/instruction, leadership, early childhood development, parent engagement, and other key success factors
* Reinforce program policies and procedures through role modeling, coaching, and performance management
* Assessment \& Reporting
* Maintain an individual development plan documenting goals, observations, learning outcomes, and progress for each student
* Maintain program attendance records and OFCY
* Provide insight to ASLA Manager on Program Monthly Reports
* Work with ASLA Manager to facilitate collection of program data for grant reporting purposes
* **Additional duties as required**
* EOYDC is a community\-based organization, and that community spirit shows up in how we work with each other. There may be times that are considered “all hands on deck,” and all team members are expected to jump in and support.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and experience equivalent to:

* Participation in/completion of a specialized program and/or pursuing a certification or degree in education, child development, or a related field strongly preferred
* At least 3 years working directly with elementary school and/or middle school students\-\-strong preference for at least one of those years being primary lead for classroom management and/or program coordination
* Demonstrated commitment to serving systematically marginalized communities with dignity and respect
* Highly organized with strong time\-management
* Must be patient, flexible, responsible, and enjoy being with students
* Must be available to work between 25\-30 hours per week, primarily on\-site during regular program hours
* Non\-profit experience preferred
* Bilingual Spanish/English a plus

**COMPENSATION**

This is a part\-time, temporary hourly position (25\-30 hours/week). The compensation is $23\-$27 hourly (depending on experience) \+ excellent benefits including health (health plan 100% employer\-paid), dental and retirement (starting 30% 403b match).

**OUR COMMITMENT TO BELONGING, DIGNITY, JUSTICE, AND JOY**

Located in a primarily Black and Brown community grappling with decades of systemic oppression, EOYDC is committed to advancing racial and socioeconomic equity and justice in all that we do. EOYDC intentionally cultivates a climate in which young people feel a sense of belonging, dignity, and joy. Key to this is fostering a relational, healing\-centered, culturally sustaining approach, while centering those most systematically marginalized.

"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.



A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

East Palo Alto

Full Time Permanent co\-worker

2026\-09\-29

  
Why we will love you
 Lead the end\-to\-end daily running fulfilment unit operations. Lead, coach and develop the operational teams, as well as ensure performance with high quality at lowest possible costs and the customer in focus, keeping an everyday safe, sustainable and healthy work environment in mind.
 What you'll be doing day to day
 The Fulfilment Operations Manager contributes to a seamless customer experience by securing a safe, efficient, and customer‑centric goods flow process that enables exceptional product availability and order fulfillment at the lowest possible cost. This role leads daily fulfilment operations, drives continuous improvement, and strengthens partnerships that support long‑term sustainable business growth.
  

  

* Lead and secure an efficient, high‑quality goods flow process across inbound, replenishment, warehousing, order fulfillment, and outbound operations.
* Maintain and optimize a living capacity plan that ensures strong product availability, accurate replenishment, and timely customer order fulfillment.
* Implement operational improvements, new technologies, and modern ways of working to enhance efficiency and elevate both the customer and co‑worker experience.
* Collaborate closely with Fulfilment Integration, Unit Management, support functions, and external transport/service providers to secure cost‑effective end‑to‑end fulfilment.
* Strengthen communication with inbound and outbound transport planning teams to optimize delivery performance and goods availability.
* Ensure all fulfilment operations comply with IKEA standards, the IKEA Code of Conduct, and local laws related to health, safety, security, and environmental regulations.
* Lead and support the implementation of the Customer Fulfilment Sustainability agenda, taking actions to reduce environmental impact and enable long‑term sustainable profitability.
* Contribute to the development and execution of local business and logistics action plans, aligning operational goals with broader unit strategies.
* Lead, coach, develop, and inspire a high‑performing Fulfilment Operations team, driving competence development, performance culture, and succession planning.
* Foster an inclusive, values‑driven, and safe work environment that embraces diversity, ensures well‑being, and strengthens the IKEA culture.
 Together as a team
 We’re the team behind the scenes that make the IKEA products available to the many people. As a diverse mix of co\-workers we use our supply process expertise to balance range and space capacity with forecasting and ordering to provide customers with high availability while minimizing costs. If you’ve wonder who’s responsible for finding effective and efficient ways of picking up the products for our customers, that’s us. We’re passionate about working together to improve the customer experience at IKEA!

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Sr. Marketing Operations Manager role serves as a critical bridge between AWS Marketing Strategy, Operations, and Enablement (MSOE) to Senior Leaders throughout AWS Marketing. In this role, you will work closely across AWS Marketing to continuously improve processes, drive execution excellence, and deliver marketing results. You will be aligned to an AWS Marketing Team and have direct responsibility for annual planning, budget management, headcount management, rhythms of the business, ad hoc reporting, and enablement. This will be done through your ability to orchestrate the right people and teams to deliver against a defined request, project, or program. This is a data\-driven role that has the opportunity to influence marketing programs and the type of data the team looks at to make strategic decisions. This role also has the ability to improve AWS Marketing performance by developing policies, programs, training, and processes to increase team productivity, return on investment, and execution quality.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Team player comfortable and motivated working in a collaborative environment with the ability to build relationships with key stakeholders at levels of seniority

  

* Establish structured collaboration mechanisms: Build and maintain interlocks with teams such as AWS Marketing, AWS Sales Operations, AWS Sales, and AWS MSOE —ensuring seamless information flow between teams whether joining existing processes or establishing new ones.

  

* Enable understanding of marketing strategy and measurement: Translate global marketing strategy into clear narratives explaining marketing measurement framework, measurement methodologies, investment allocation logic, and the rationale behind coverage decisions—providing content and materials that Marketing Leaders can use to ensure their audience whether sellers, partners, or other marketers understands what marketing does, how it's measured, and why.

  

* Deliver performance reporting and insights at various altitudes (geo, channel, or segment) and formats (written narrative, power point presentation, oral presentation) like : Deliver comprehensive performance commentary and actionable insights to the AWS Marketing Leaders that make marketing's full impact visible, including pipeline results, and key trends in activity.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross\-functional teams and agency partners
* Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
* Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
* Experience in a business\-to\-business (B2B) environment, high\-tech products/services

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of post Master's, full\-time relevant industry (professional or military) experience

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Marketing Systems
jobs.description:
Marcom is the creatively\-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world\-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.  

  

Sr. Program Manager of Marketing Systems leads the operational execution, management, and governance of the critical digital frameworks and initiatives that define Interactive’s global presence. This role is a strategic lead accountable for ensuring that complex digital programs, ranging from design systems to marketing platform optimizations, are delivered with operational rigor and measurable outcomes, while partnering closely with engineering to deliver scalable, performant solutions.  

  

**Description**  

  

The role serves as a primary connective node between Design, Engineering, and Product, driving shared accountability, removing systemic blockers, and ensuring cross\-functional alignment at every stage of delivery. This includes partnering across product management and engineering to ensure business needs are met, from operational Worldwide (WW) workflow definition and optimization, to contributing into measurement frameworks that track go\-to\-market (GTM) velocity and program impact. The role operates with discretion, managing large\-scale initiatives and regularly engaging senior leadership to drive the evolution of digital transformation.  

  

This role drives the programmatic delivery and governance of marketing systems and digital frameworks that power Interactive’s global web presence, serving as the operational bridge between Design, Engineering, and Product to ensure complex initiatives ship with quality, scalability, and measurable business impact.","responsibilities":"Lead the translation of creative and business intent into operational roadmaps that preserve quality standards while enabling multi\-platform global reuse across Interactive’s portfolio.  

  

Own the programmatic readiness, rollout sequencing, and cross\-team coordination required to deploy the Unified Design System (UDS) into production workflows at scale.  

  

Establish and refine fiscal year and quarterly roadmaps aligned with Marcom Interactive priorities, driving delivery, quality, and timeline outcomes across multiple concurrent work tracks.  

  

Partner with Engineering and Product Management to translate business requirements into platform capabilities, including workflow optimization, measurement instrumentation, and go\-to\-market velocity tracking.  

  

Define and maintain the operational cadence, including stand\-ups, planning sessions, retrospectives, and milestone reviews; ensuring consistency and accountability across all work\-streams.  

  

Identify and eliminate recurring process bottlenecks through root\-cause analysis, implementing systemic fixes rather than one\-off workarounds.  

  

Facilitate trade\-offs between bespoke creative expression and scalable system reuse, guiding teams toward decisions that balance creative excellence with operational efficiency.  

  

Engage regularly with senior leadership across Experiences, Communications, and Engineering to drive alignment, report on program health, and course\-correct as needed.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Background working with or alongside design systems teams (contribution models, governance, adoption metrics).  

  

Experience in a marketing organization at a consumer technology company, with familiarity in how global web content is produced, localized, and published at scale.

jobs.title: Regional Commercial Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

The application window will be open until at least October 5, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Thornton, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience in the energy sector.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience applying AI or other technical tools to automate processes and perform complex analyses.
* Experience with cross\-functional stakeholder management and communication strategy.
* Experience with cost benchmarking and analyzing financial performance for acquisition agreements.
* Experience with executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to drive change management, build awareness, and ensure process adoption across regional teams.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Global Infrastructure and Energy organization is responsible to deliver the infrastructure to host and connect every machine and every user on the internet, with carbon free energy (CFE). As part of the Commercial Operations arm within the Global Operations for Assets and Tooling team, we are responsible to help the strategic negotiators land agreements quickly and be able to maximize our returns.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Analyze and report unit costs associated with network acquisition agreements to inform leadership business strategy and equip negotiators for future discussions.
* Track utilization of approved budgets against contract execution, and prepare the essential data for regular leadership reporting.
* Collaborate closely with regional teams to ensure accurate entry of key agreement terms, project details, and forecasts into required tools, confirming adherence to established processes.
* Liaise with central program manager to implement changes in the region, driving awareness and adoption.
* Apply AI to automate processes and perform complex analyses.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Inventory Control Operations Manager
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.


Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Own the weekly inventory\-accuracy operating rhythm across contract manufacturer and warehouse sites, including cycle\-count performance, adjustment tracking, variance resolution, and key control metrics.
* Manage cycle\-count programs end\-to\-end: count scheduling, ABC classification, variance investigation, reconciliation, and closure.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies across receiving, storage, material movement, and system transactions; lead root\-cause analysis and corrective action plans for recurring errors.
* Review weekly site\-level results, identify performance gaps, and drive timely containment and corrective actions with internal teams and external partners.
* Compare physical inventory to ERP and WMS records, guaranteeing discrepancies are thoroughly recorded and rectified.
* Monitor partner adherence to inventory\-control procedures, transaction rigor, and service\-level expectations.
* Maintain inventory\-control dashboards, scorecards, and SOPs; advance significant risks and unresolved discrepancies with clear impact assessments.

**What we need to see:**

* 8\+ years of experience in inventory control, warehouse operations, or a related supply\-chain function, along with a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Hands\-on experience managing inventory accuracy and cycle\-count programs in warehouse, manufacturing, or distribution environments.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate physical\-to\-system discrepancies and drive issues through reconciliation and closure.
* Experience managing weekly operational metrics, site\-performance reviews, corrective actions, and partner follow\-up.
* Experience working with ERP and WMS platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Manhattan, or similar systems.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel and experience developing operational reports, dashboards, and scorecards.
* Ability to lead cross\-functional problem\-solving and influence internal and external teams without direct authority.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience supporting multi\-site or global service, repair, or warehouse operations with contract manufacturers or 3PLs.
* Advanced skills in SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, or Python for inventory analytics and exception reporting.
* Knowledge of inventory accounting, cost accounting, or audit controls and their working\-capital implications.
* Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous\-improvement methodologies to inventory accuracy problems.
* APICS/ASCM, CPIM, CSCP, or Lean Six Sigma certification.


With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. This role presents an opportunity to have a wide impact at NVIDIA by improving the factory planning function. Are you creative, hard\-working, dedicated, and determined? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you!


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 124,000 USD \- 195,500 USD for Level 4, and 148,000 USD \- 235,750 USD for Level 5\.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.


Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 25, 2026\.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.


NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.


NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations Manager

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Allied Universal® is hiring an Operations Manager. The Operations Manager is a central leader in ensuring successful delivery of security services across assigned client sites. This role oversees frontline hiring, staffing, scheduling, training, and operational compliance while serving as a critical support and escalation point for employees and clients. The Operations Manager will champion high‑quality service, workforce stability, and operational consistency by proactively addressing performance concerns, maintaining contractual staffing levels, and building strong client relationships Why Join Allied Universal?
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
Selection and Placement* Manage the selection and placement process for new security professionals, including first\-line supervisors; design and implement career development and performance improvement plans; evaluate low\-performing employees for replacement, upgrade or transfer
* Make initial job offers (for new employees) and job transfers (for existing employees) using company forms and procedures, offering rates, schedules and benefits in alignment with post contract requirements; maintain and publish weekly Open Post List and actively manage job openings within division/branch


Schedule and Workforce Management* Create, modify and manage post schedules in WinTeam to ensure adequate coverage at all times; ensure schedules are properly maintained in WinTeam and are updated regularly
* Ensure all positions are staffed according to contract requirements and effectively manage branch overtime through proper scheduling and staffing; maintain a qualified, sufficient pool of flex personnel for backfill of vacant positions as needed
* Maintain regular proactive contact with Security Professionals to ensure all staff is being effectively utilized, properly trained, and ready for placement as needed. Review “No Hours Report” with branch Human Resource staff on a weekly basis, and disposition employees who are on “active” status with no hours, in accordance with company policies, ensuring no employees remain on “no hours” status beyond 3 weeks


Payroll Management* Receive weekly timesheets and update WinTeam schedules as necessary (verify such for self\-scheduling accounts); run weekly payroll according to company procedures. Ensure records are properly maintained and updated to reduce payroll errors; resolve payroll discrepancies in a timely and efficient manner, and communicate status of such to affected employees, to minimize financial exposure for Company
* Follow all company policies regarding timekeeping procedures, meal and rest period breaks (where applicable), ensuring signatures and acknowledgements are properly documented (where applicable), and conducting weekly audits of timekeeping records to ensure accuracy
* Process requests for final paychecks, anniversary bonuses and other pay related issues, and execute the distribution of such pay; act as a Company representative in such matters as unemployment hearings, workers’ compensation hearings/depositions, union meetings (where applicable), state agency activities, depositions, and other related liability matters


Employee Relations* Conduct disciplinary and counseling sessions with Security Professionals as needed in a proactive and professional manner. Ensure all such issues are documented according to company standards, and that all issues receive proper follow up for resolution
* Initiate termination procedures as needed for voluntary and involuntary separations; execute termination meetings as necessary and complete all follow up documentation according to company standards
* Maintain high employee morale and low employee turnover through effective and proactive communications and timely problem resolution; ensure all hiring, counseling, disciplinary and termination procedures are executed in a consistent manner
* Ensure a smooth running operation by enforcing post specific policies and procedures through proper communication and training; may utilize field training staff to assist in executing post\-specific training

**QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE):*** High School diploma or equivalent
* Current driver’s license if driving a company vehicle, or personal vehicle in the course of conducting business (e.g., client visits, attending networking events)
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
* Minimum of three (3\) years of leadership experience in a high\-volume workforce environment, preferably in the protective service industry
* Work experience in successfully building and developing teams
* Leadership skills that foster teamwork, innovation, agility, client relations and achieving desired results
* Ability to maintain a profitable book of business by cross\-collaborating and utilizing results\-oriented problem\-solving skills to meet both client and employee growth and satisfaction
* Proficiency in web\-based applications and computer systems, including Microsoft Office and (BI) Business Intelligence tools for metrics analysis, reporting, automation, and presentations
* Dynamic networking skills displaying a commitment to safety and trust by participating in local community, client and industry events
* Basic understanding of financial principles, including budgeting and financial reporting; ability to interpret simple financial data and use it to support decision\-making

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):*** College degree in criminal justice, business administration

The Operations Manager is responsible for reducing risk, responding to incidents, and limiting exposure to liability within the client Global Safety \& Security operations. The Operations Manager will partner with the client Global Safety \& Security Management team to develop, implement and manage physical security, safety, executive protection, special events, investigations and risk management programs that align with the client culture, values and policies. * A dynamic and challenging work environment with opportunity for growth

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Influencer Marketing
jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesMarketing and CommunicationsID: 42920
  
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.


At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.


A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We're looking for a Manager of Influencer Marketing to build and scale the operational backbone of our global influencer program. This is not a traditional campaign role — you'll be the person who turns creator relationships and regional programs into a repeatable, data\-driven machine. You'll own the systems, playbooks, and tools that allow our influencer marketing team to operate efficiently at scale across markets and content types.



This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and program operations, and is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, loves building things from scratch, and is energized by the challenge of bringing structure to a fast\-moving space.


**You will:**
-------------


**Program Operations \& Scale**


* Design and manage the operational infrastructure for a global influencer program spanning multiple content types, markets, and campaign types
* Partner with web systems team to manage front\-end, creator facing authenticated portal as well as back\-end systems
* Build scalable workflows in our CRM system for influencer sourcing, contracting, onboarding, activation, and reporting — reducing manual lift while increasing output
* Define and maintain program standards, SLAs, and intake processes across internal stakeholders and external partners
* Partner with legal, finance, and other internal and external partners to streamline contracting and payment operations globally


**Global Playbooks**


* Develop and maintain a suite of global playbooks covering influencer program application management, relationship tiering, campaign briefing, content guidelines, and performance benchmarking
* Localize frameworks for regional teams while preserving global consistency in brand standards and measurement methodology
* Establish best practices for new program verticals (e.g., live events, product launches, always\-on ambassador programs) and codify learnings into repeatable resources
* Train and enable cross\-functional partners and regional teams on playbook adoption


**CRM \& Tooling**


* Lead the buildout of a centralized influencer CRM and creator\-facing portal — defining data architecture, contact management standards, tagging taxonomy, and relationship history tracking
* Build, evaluate, implement, and own influencer marketing technology (CRM platforms, discovery tools, reporting dashboards) and serve as the internal subject matter expert
* Partner with data and analytics teams to develop dashboards that give real\-time visibility into program health, creator performance, and spend efficiency
* Ensure creator\-facing portal is dynamic and up to date with our backend updates, and tooling for influencers adoption and usage.
* Identify gaps in existing tooling and build or commission solutions that reduce friction and improve team output


**You have:**
-------------


* 8\-10 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or a closely related field, with at least 2 years in a role focused on operations, program management, or marketing technology
* Exceptional project management skills — highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a rapidly changing environment
* Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving influencer marketing infrastructure — playbooks, workflows, CRM systems, or reporting tools
* Comfort operating across global markets and working with regional teams to adapt centralized frameworks
* Strong analytical skills; able to work fluently with data to drive decisions and communicate program performance to leadership
* Clear, concise communicator who can translate complex operational concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* A bias toward building: you'd rather create a system than patch a problem
* Experience in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech — particularly with creator ecosystems tied to UGC or live platforms
* Familiarity with influencer contract structures, FTC guidelines, and international compliance considerations
* Background in or exposure to marketing analytics, business intelligence tools, or data pipeline basics
* Experience supporting large\-scale live events or product launches with influencer programming components

jobs.title: GTM Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

As a GTM Sales Operations Manager, you are a highly motivated self\-starter who is responsible for driving critical initiatives in the Salesforce account, contact data quality and account hierarchies across our Europe, LATAM, Asia, and Japan regions. This role involves direct engagement with regional Sales and GTM teams. You will partner directly with regional Sales and GTM teams to execute data quality strategies using AI\-driven transformations, enrichment improvements, and coordinated onshore/offshore delivery.  

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Director of Data Governance and Strategy.  

**Responsibility**
* Execute regional data quality initiatives focusing on firmographics, account hierarchies and deduplication across Europe, LATAM, APAC, and Japan markets
* Develop and enforce data standards, governance policies, and parent\-child relationship rules aligned with regional compliance requirements
* Build and maintain regional data quality dashboards with monthly KPI tracking and executive visibility to Sales and GTM leadership
* Deploy AI agents and automation workflows to scale data cleansing and enrichment and make material data quality improvements
* Identify and evaluate emerging data technologies and tools to improve operational efficiency
* Write new business requirements (BRDs) and specifications for data quality initiatives, automation workflows, and GTM system enhancements
* Coordinate closely with internal IT team to ensure technical feasibility, security compliance, and alignment with data infrastructure standards
* Participate in prioritization sessions to assess business impact of data initiatives and ensure resources are allocated to highest\-value opportunities
* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new data systems, automation tools, and process changes; validate that solutions meet regional business requirements
* Document UAT findings, coordinate remediation with IT and vendors, and sign\-off on production deployment
* Partner closely with regional Marketing, Customer Success, Partner, Sales Operations, RevOps, and GTM teams to understand data requirements and drive adoption of data standards
* Communicate regional data quality insights and recommendations to Sales and GTM leadership through presentations, reports, and dashboards
* Coordinate execution with central data governance team and offshore contractors to deliver consistent, high\-quality data improvements
* Lead offshore team performance management, training, and quality assurance
* Drive adoption of GTM data standards and processes in regional markets

**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

As a CS Strategy \& Operations Program Manager, you will be responsible for designing, owning, and driving the company's most complex and mission\-critical transformation programs for Customer Success. This role extends beyond managing project timelines to leading the successful execution of key initiatives, ensuring that all initiatives are strategically aligned, integrated, and deliver significant, measurable business value. jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Job summary  

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer\-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data\-driven decisions and analytical problem\-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.  

  

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile \- where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile \- where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile \- when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.  

  

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:  

* Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
* Lead large\-scope projects with site and regional impact
* Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* Experience managing a team of 2\+ salaried employees and 70\+ indirect employees
* Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
* Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
* Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
* Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
* Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Life Sciences - Reinvention Program Manager
jobs.description:
We are:


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

  

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

  

About the role:

* The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
* This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.
* This is not a traditional PMO role — it is an AI\-enabled program manager who uses automation to do what once required a team.

  

The Work:

* Manage project communications, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting across all transformation workstreams — giving the Portfolio Strategy \& Value Lead the visibility needed to govern effectively
* Track budget actuals against plan, surface variances early, and support governance reporting to the client's transformation leadership
* Leverage AI\-powered project management tools and automation to streamline program operations — this role is expected to be a practitioner of the tools deployed
* Coordinate across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators to maintain an integrated view of progress, dependencies, and risks
* Maintain the operating cadence: cadence calls, status reports, risk logs, and action tracking across a fast\-moving transformation engagement

  

You are:


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.


  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:

  

* Program or project management at a top\-tier consulting firm or in a complex enterprise delivery environment, with demonstrated experience managing multi\-workstream programs from initiation through completion.
* A proven track record designing and maintaining program operating rhythms — including cadence calls, status reporting, risk logs, and budget tracking — for senior executive audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered project management and automation tools to improve program visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Strong executive\-ready written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program status into clear, decision\-ready materials.
* Experience coordinating across multidisciplinary teams including consultants, technologists, and change practitioners.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

  

Preferred skills/experience:

  

* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMP, Agile/Scrum (CSM, SAFe), or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience managing AI\-enabled transformation programs or enterprise change initiatives in Life Sciences.
* Familiarity with AI agent orchestration tools for program reporting, status automation, or backlog management.
* Track record at a top\-tier consulting firm managing large\-scale transformation program delivery across multiple simultaneous workstreams.

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.title: Staff Program Manager: Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Join Intuit as a **Staff** **Program Manager** on the Customer Success team. This is a high\-impact role for someone who enjoys building structure, driving execution, and turning complex ideas into clear, actionable programs.


In this role, you’ll help design and run cross\-functional programs that support our global customer base. You’ll work in ambiguous spaces, partner closely with product, operations, and go\-to\-market teams, and bring order, clarity, and momentum to important initiatives. You’ll be responsible for coordinating work across teams, tracking progress, surfacing risks, and ensuring programs move forward efficiently and deliver meaningful outcomes.

  

This role requires strong operational fundamentals, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once. You’ll regularly present updates and recommendations to stakeholders, collaborate with senior leaders, and help translate strategy into execution.

 **Responsibilities**

**Program Design \& Launch:** Support the design and launch of cross\-functional programs, helping define scope, milestones, ownership, and success metrics aligned to Customer Success and GBSG goals.

**Coordinate \& Execute:** Drive day\-to\-day execution by organizing workstreams, maintaining operating rhythms, and ensuring teams stay aligned, informed, and unblocked.

**Operational Excellence:** Track progress, manage dependencies and risks, and use data to keep programs on track and delivering measurable results for customers.

**Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with product, engineering, marketing, and operations teams to align priorities, clarify expectations, and move work forward.

**Clear Communication:** Deliver concise, relevant updates to stakeholders, clearly outlining status, risks, decisions needed, and next steps.

**Decision Support:** Help identify trade\-offs, prepare recommendations, and escalate issues when needed with clear context and data.

 **Adapt \& Improve:** Anticipate challenges, adjust plans as needed, and continuously improve processes to increase team efficiency and program impact.

 **Qualifications**

* **7\+ years** of experience supporting or leading cross\-functional programs in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Experience working in ambiguous problem spaces and helping bring structure, clarity, and momentum to new initiatives.
* Strong program management fundamentals, including planning, execution tracking, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to use metrics to inform decisions and communicate progress and risks.
* Comfortable managing up and across teams, with experience presenting updates and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate at both the strategic level (understanding goals and priorities) and the tactical level (driving day\-to\-day execution).
* Clear, effective communicator across written and verbal formats.
* Strong collaborator who can influence without authority and build trust across teams.
* Passion for customer success and delivering real, measurable impact.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

San Diego $150,000 \- $203,000

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition ID \# 170610
  
  

**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** San Ramon
  
  

Department Overview
  
  

Engineering, Planning \& Strategy will play a leading role in showing California and the world how PG\&E will meet California’s decarbonization and resilience goals while improving safety, affordability and reliability. The Large Load Project Management Team is responsible for delivering complex, high\-capacity electric infrastructure projects that support major commercial and industrial customers. These projects often involve multi\-phase transmission and distribution upgrades, regulatory compliance, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders to meet customer timelines and strategic commitments.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

This job is represented by Engineers and Scientists of California (ESC) subject to collective bargaining.
  
  

This position, under general direction, exercises judgment and discretion and is responsible for all aspects of the development and implementation of assigned projects and provides a single point of contact for those projects. Project duration is generally multi\-year, requires significant risk management, and may include formal partnering agreements with outside firms. Assignments will have high visibility, require extensive project management skills and often require specific discipline and areas of expertise, such as:
  
  

Electric transmission substation projects
  
Electric transmission line projects
  
  

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need.
  
  

PG\&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to these factors.
  
  

**The salary range is:**  

CA Minimum, $161,520
  
CA Maximum, $207,504
  
  

Job Responsibilities
  
  

Provides leadership, coaching, technical direction, and oversight for assigned projects; also provides knowledge transfer and assistance to many technical and/or project management employees and teams.
  
Proactively controls the scope, schedule, cost, and quality of a large portfolio of projects throughout the project life cycle.
  
Provides extensive knowledge and guidance to others in start\-up testing, inspections, and condition assessment; actively supports complex and/or large project start\-up tests and field inspections.
  
Provides guidance to engineering on producing complex risk and alternative analyses, studies and conceptual designs for presentation to project sponsors and/or leadership.
  
Oversees and administrates EPC contracts.
  
Negotiates third party contracts, in support of other departments when appropriate.
  
Makes presentations to PG\&E Officers as appropriate.
  
Arbitrates and resolves conflicts within the project.
  
Mentors and provides guidance to less experienced project managers.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Minimum:**  

Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) from an accredited college\*
  
8 years of PG\&E (9 years outside) of relevant experience in electric, gas, or power generation operations, engineering, business planning, accounting, finance, construction management, or project management
  
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  
  

* In lieu of a four (4\) year degree, candidates may qualify with twelve (12\) or more years of directly related work experience in areas such as accounting, engineering, construction management, project scheduling, or project controls, with responsibilities comparable to those outlined for this role. External hires must have a minimum of thirteen (13\) years of applicable experience.


**Desired:**  

Electrical Engineering Degree for the Substation projects and Civil Engineering for Transmission line projects
  
Knowledge of and experience with electric substations, and transmission line projects
  
Fluent in the use of Project Management tools and current company tools, such as SAP Financials and Work Management modules and Microsoft Project Scheduling Software
  
Superior ability to interface with and across supporting organizations and conduct formal presentations to officers.
  
Knowledge of land acquisition, CPUC and environmental permitting, and EPC contracting procedures.
  
Demonstrated ability to lead multiple medium to large scale complex projects; provide resolution of complex technical and/or contractual issues; and/or provide Project Management on multiple projects with complex scope requiring non\-standard approaches; without supervision.
  
Demonstrated application of extensive project management skills, including seasoned and experience\-based judgment and organizational business acumen in applying and adapting traditional project management techniques.
  
Demonstrates extensive contracting knowledge and contract negotiation and management skills.
  
Demonstrates excellent verbal and written communication skills, utilizes a variety of styles to connect with the intended audience, and able to present complex information to upper management on a variety of topics.
  
Builds consensus around complex and controversial project \& technical issues.
  
Demonstrated high quality work by self and others on project team.

jobs.title: Event Project Manager — Signage & Experiential
jobs.description:
VIVAS is a San Francisco signage company. We design, print, fabricate and install signage and large\-format graphics for offices, buildings, retail spaces and events across the Bay Area. Our shop is in the Bayview and our crews work all over the Bay Area.

Half of our work is events and experiential: booths, SEG fabric backdrops, environmental graphics and full venue branding for conferences, activations and large\-scale productions. We're hiring a second Event Project Manager to run events end to end alongside our current PM. In events the date cannot move. Your job is to make sure that on the morning of the event, everything is printed, loaded, delivered and installed — and that nothing about it was a surprise.

**What you'll do**

* Run the project from kickoff to closeout, working backwards from the event date
* Coordinate with venues: load\-in windows, dock access, badges, permits, certificates of insurance
* Keep every job documented and current in Monday, our project system
* Chase artwork through to client approval before it reaches production
* Be on site for install and strike — this is not a desk\-only role
* Close the project out: final walkthrough, photos, and a clean handoff back to the account owner
* Flag a problem the day you see it, not the week of the event

**What we're looking for**

* 2\+ years coordinating events, trade shows, productions, or projects with a hard deadline
* Someone organized enough to hold twenty moving pieces without a single one going quiet
* Comfortable talking to venue operations staff, vendors and clients
* Calm on site when something doesn't match the plan — because it will
* Available for early mornings, evenings and occasional weekends when that's the only install window a venue gives us
* English and Spanish is a strong plus — our shop and crew work in both
* Valid driver's license
* Experience with signage, print or fabrication is a plus, not a requirement — we'll teach you the materials

**What we offer**

* $30\.00 – $35\.00 per hour, depending on experience
* Full time, hourly and overtime eligible — we pay for the hours the job actually takes
* Paid sick leave under San Francisco law
* A clear path: this role grows into owning the delivered margin of your projects, not just the delivery
* Work at venues and events you'll recognize across the Bay Area

**Schedule and location**

Based at our shop at 2265 Revere Ave, San Francisco, and on site at venues across the Bay Area. Monday to Friday, with early mornings, evenings and weekends as event load\-ins require. Overtime is paid at the rate California law requires.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed, or at jobs.vivasinc.com — both land in the same inbox. Tell us about one event or project you ran where the date could not move, and what nearly went wrong. We read every application.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Exhibition Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About FOR\-SITE**

Established by Chief Curator and Executive Director Cheryl Haines in 2003, FOR\-SITE is dedicated to the creation, understanding, and presentation of art about place. Through exhibitions, commissions, and educational programs, FOR\-SITE supports the creation and presentation of art that inspires fresh thinking and dialogue about our natural and cultural environment. www.for\-site.org

**Position Summary** 

The Exhibition Project Manager plays a key integrative role in the organization, ensuring the smooth and efficient planning and delivery of FOR\-SITE’s exhibitions. Reporting to the Chief Curator and Executive Director (CCED) and collaborating closely with FOR\-SITE staff and contractors, this position combines exhibition research and project management with organizational and administrative support—helping to guide large\-scale, site\-specific exhibitions from early\-stage development through production, installation, and maintenance.

This is an in\-person, full\-time position at FOR\-SITE’s San Francisco office, located at Fort Mason Center for Arts \& Culture.

The ideal candidate will be highly organized, resourceful, and collaborative, with strong project\-management experience in a nonprofit arts setting.

**Key Responsibilities and Duties**

* At the direction of the CCED, **conduct and compile research** on artists, artworks, and sites for current and future exhibitions.
* Communicate effectively with artists, project partners, vendors, contractors, and fabricators to **manage the preparation of exhibition sites and the production and transportation of artworks.**
* **Manage artwork installation, maintenance, and de\-installation**; supervise installation crews, and oversee on\-site logistics.
* Draft, execute, and manage **artist contracts and loan agreements**.
* **Track project budgets, expenses, and invoices**
* **Provide project and administrative support to the CCED**, including correspondence, scheduling, research, and strategic planning, acting as a point of contact as needed.
* **Prepare briefing materials, presentations, and other documentation** to support FOR\-SITE's exhibition program.
* **Coordinate meetings, travel, and communications** with internal and external stakeholders, including FOR\-SITE board meetings.
* Work with the CCED to **secure necessary permits**; liaise with exhibition partners to facilitate project compliance and review processes.
* **Coordinate the work of volunteers, interns, and vendors**.
* Represent FOR\-SITE at art community and outreach events.

**Desired Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of experience planning and managing the logistics and installation of art exhibitions.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail; a creative thinker with strong problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with Mac OS, Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, Dropbox, database management, and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Excellent verbal, written, and listening communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Knowledge of contemporary art, artists, and institutions is a significant plus.
* Bachelor's degree in nonprofit administration, arts administration, museum studies, public art, or art history.

FOR\-SITE strives to attract a diverse group of candidates for employment. We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and are dedicated to fair and inclusive employment practices.

**Work Schedule, Salary, and Benefits**

Full\-time, exempt position

Location: FOR\-SITE offices, Fort Mason Center for Arts \& Culture

Schedule: Monday–Friday; occasional evening and weekend work

Starting Salary: $75,000 annually

Benefits: Health insurance, dental insurance, and paid time off

**How to Apply**

**Please email a resume and cover letter to haley@for\-site.org with Exhibition Project Manager in the subject line. No phone calls please.**

Pay: $75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Please submit a CV, cover letter, and three work samples to haley@for\-site.org that demonstrate your communications experience, writing ability, and/or experience with arts\-related public engagement. Have you contacted haley@for\-site.org directly?

Work Location: In person
