jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.


Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research. As a Project Support Associate, you'll support clinical trials by managing project documentation, coordinating supply chain activities, and ensuring consistent delivery of services. Work closely with internal teams and clients to support study success while maintaining the highest quality standards. You'll handle project planning, documentation management, and cross\-functional coordination to meet timelines and client expectations.

**Position Summary**


The Project Support Associate works with other project managers in a small pod, helping them manage a group of shared projects. The pod shares responsibility for projects and ensures tasks are completed by an appropriately leveled project manager. This position is tactical in nature and responsible for shepherding tasks to completion, resolving issues within internal procedures, and acting as the primary point of contact for low\-complexity client accounts. The team works cross\-functionally to ensure that client requirements and timelines are met. Focusing on building relationships with the client and delivering an excellent customer experience.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provides context and drives consensus internally, serves as a customer advocate. Monitors and bills day\-to\-day project activity. Reports vital issues to team and management.
* Coordinates and assists in setting up and maintaining study filing system, accurately records and captures specifications for each project. Uses digital tools to visualize project landmarks and allow synchronized sharing of knowledge.
* Provides internal/external partners with updates regarding timelines, shipping issues and delays. Coordinates production schedules to work within team capacity and aids in troubleshooting problems. Participates in creation of operations documentation
* Generates, checks and provides required reports to client.
* Timely initiation of all services in accordance with client timelines.
* Backs up the project management team.
* Carries out all tasks in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices.

**Education**


High school diploma is required, a degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.

**Experience**


Position requires 1\-2 years of successful experience in project management as a project coordinator, lab technician or equivalent experience in a customer\-facing environment. In some cases, an equivalency consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

**Basic Minimum Qualifications**


Must be on\-site at our Thermo Fisher Scientific Vacaville, CA location.


Successful candidates will have strong project management skills such as excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to present information and answer questions for clients and management. Will be expected to be able to multitask and coordinate tasks across functional teams while maintaining attention to detail and drive problem solving.


In this team we must be adaptable and able to work in a variety of commercial and custom in\-house software. Proficiency in MS Office Suite is required and knowledge of Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, and TrackWise are advantageous.


Should be intellectually curious and results oriented.


Occasional travel may be required. The physical demands described above are representative of what is needed to complete this work. However, reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to be successful.

**Compensation and Benefits**


The hourly pay range estimated for this position based in California is $23\.04–$34\.56\.
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short\- and long\-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount


For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total\-rewards

jobs.title: Data Center Project Manager, US-West CPI, Critical Projects Implementation
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operation data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.  

  

We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.  

  

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think big; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!  

  

A day in the life  

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.
  

  

About the team  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

\#DCCD\_AMER


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of construction or project management experience
* 5\+ years experience managing projects in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure in an operational space. Comparable critical infrastructure experience is defined as a facility that includes a 24/7 emergency backup system, manufacturing facility (semiconductor, auto, medical equipment or Clean rooms), Mass Transportation (freight or passenger rail), Oil and Gas, Utility, Hospitals or similar industry
* 5\+ years in on\-site construction trades (mechanical, electrical, general) Vendor Management

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* 5\+ years experience managing projects in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure in an operational space. Comparable critical infrastructure experience is defined as a facility that includes a 24/7 emergency backup system, manufacturing facility (semiconductor, auto, medical equipment or Clean rooms), Mass Transportation (freight or passenger rail), Oil and Gas, Utility, Hospitals or similar industry
* 5\+ years

jobs.title: Supply Chain Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Supply Chain Project Manager**

**Location:** San Jose, California
  

**Department:** Supply Chain / Operations
  

**Reports To:** Director of Operations
  

**Effective Date:** 9/18/26  



**Role Purpose**

The Supply Chain Project Manager leads purchasing, material planning, inventory control, and supplier performance to support Elcon Precision’s production, quality, delivery, and customer requirements. The role develops and implements supply chain solutions, supports cross‑functional initiatives, mentors junior staff, and drives continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with company procedures, quality‑system requirements, and U.S. export‑control obligations.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day‑to‑day purchasing, planning, inventory control, and supplier coordination.
* Create and maintain material and purchasing plans aligned with demand, production schedules, lead times, and business priorities.
* Select, qualify, and manage suppliers; negotiate pricing, terms, and delivery commitments.
* Monitor supplier quality, delivery, responsiveness, capacity, and cost; lead corrective actions when needed.
* Maintain inventory levels that support production while minimizing excess, obsolescence, and working‑capital impact.
* Resolve shortages, past‑due orders, long‑lead items, and supply bottlenecks; communicate risks proactively.
* Collaborate with Production, Quality, Engineering, Sales, and Finance on supply decisions and operational objectives.
* Support engineering changes, product transitions, and new product introductions by coordinating sourcing and supplier readiness.
* Maintain purchasing records, traceability documentation, certifications, and controlled information according to procedures.
* Use ERP/MRP tools to maintain accurate purchasing, planning, supplier, and inventory data.
* Track and improve KPIs including supplier on‑time delivery, supplier quality, purchase‑price performance, shortages, and inventory accuracy.
* Identify and mitigate supply continuity risks such as single‑source suppliers, long lead times, capacity issues, or logistics disruptions.
* Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits through accurate documentation and compliance evidence.
* Ensure compliance with purchasing controls, confidentiality requirements, quality standards, and export‑control rules.
* Protect controlled technical data and escalate any compliance concerns.
* Lead supply chain continuous‑improvement initiatives.
* Perform duties according to established procedures and work instructions.
* Complete additional responsibilities as needed.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7\+ years of progressive experience in supply chain, purchasing, planning, or materials management; leadership experience preferred.
* Strong background in precision manufacturing, aerospace/defense, semiconductor, electronics, or other regulated environments.
* Experience in process engineering, quality engineering, or technical sales is a plus.

**Position Summary**The Assistant Program Leader works alongside other After School Program staff to provide meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at branches, or local elementary and middle schools. This role supports program activities on an as\-needed basis, working under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors. The ideal candidate demonstrates flexibility, initiative, punctuality, and a commitment to serving youth and supporting team goals.

  




***After School Program Dates***

* *Marin Sites: August 18, 2025 – June 13, 2026*

  




**Job Responsibilities**  

**Program Support \& Activities*** Assist with implementing engaging, age\-appropriate activities that support learning, creativity, and fun.
* Help lead academic enrichment, tutoring, and recreational activities as directed by the program lead or supervisor.
* Support setup, cleanup, and preparation of program materials and spaces.

  


**Supervision \& Safety*** Actively supervise and engage with youth to ensure a safe, positive, and inclusive environment.
* Follow safety procedures and promptly report any incidents or concerns to the supervisor.
* Step in to support classroom or group supervision as needed to maintain proper staff\-to\-student ratios.

  


**Administrative Support*** Assist with maintaining accurate attendance, sign\-in/out sheets, and basic program records.

jobs.description:
**Case Manager / Patient Coordinator**

We’re looking for someone rare.

Not just a “salesperson.”

Not just a “people person.”

Someone who can care deeply AND hold the line.

Someone who can sit across from a patient in pain, truly hear them…

…and confidently guide them to make a decision that could change their life.

**This Role Is For You If:**

● You build trust quickly and naturally—people feel safe opening up to you

● You’re empathetic, but not passive—you can lead conversations with confidence

● You don’t avoid hard conversations—you handle them with clarity and care

● You believe in what you’re offering, and that conviction comes through

● You’re driven, resilient, and don’t get discouraged by objections

● You take ownership of outcomes—not just effort

**This Role Is NOT For You If:**

● You rely on pressure or “pushy” sales tactics

● You struggle to guide people toward decisions

● You avoid uncomfortable conversations

● You need constant supervision or motivation

● You’re just looking for “another sales job”

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

● Welcoming new patients and creating a strong first impression

● Leading meaningful consultations that uncover patient goals, fears, and motivations

● Educating patients on their condition and recommended care

● Guiding patients through care plan decisions with clarity and confidence

● Supporting patients with financing options when needed

● Following up to ensure patients stay engaged and committed to their care

● Collaborating with the team to create a seamless patient experience

**About the Role:**

This is not cold calling. Patients are already coming to us for help.

Your job is not to “sell” them—

It’s to help them make a decision they’ve likely been avoiding.

**That requires:**

● Emotional intelligence

● Strong communication

● Confidence under pressure

● And a genuine belief in the care we provide

**What We Offer:**

● A purpose\-driven environment where your work truly impacts lives

● A high\-demand, niche service with strong patient interest

● Structured training to help you master communication and patient conversion

● A supportive, positive team culture (no negativity, no ego\-driven sales tactics)

● Base salary \+ uncapped commission

Typical earnings: $500\-$3000\+, based on performance

What We’re Looking For:

● Sales or consultative experience preferred

● Strong interpersonal and communication skills

● High level of organization and personal accountability

● Ability to learn quickly and adapt

● Professional, reliable, and team\-oriented

Schedule:

Full\-time

Monday–Thursday: 10:00 AM–7:00 PM, Saturday 8:30 AM to 1:30 PM

This role sits at the intersection of healthcare and influence.

If you’re someone who can combine heart, confidence, and drive—

you’ll not only succeed here… you’ll thrive.

Pay: $28\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
#### **About Our Company**


WeBox is the leading intelligent marketplace delivering personalized group orders.  

WeBox is driven by three core principles: customers first, value the strivers, and build with partners.

  

### **Our Mission and Vision**


WeBox strives to deliver personalized group orders, ensuring that every group member enjoys the happiness of delivery.By 2032, we will achieve $1 billion in revenue by leveraging technology to become a leading provider of intelligent and sustainable solutions for group orders.


### **Job Summary**


WeBox, the leading intelligent marketplace for personalized group orders, is seeking a proactive and resourceful Logistics Operations Coordinator to join our team. This role ensures seamless delivery operations, focusing on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and efficiency. We're looking for someone flexible and tech\-savvy who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, manages last\-minute changes, and embodies our values of transparency, resilience, and accountability.


### **Core Responsibilities**


* **Route \& Process Optimization**: Provide support for route planning and identify key improvements to streamline delivery and sorting processes.
* **Driver \& Partner Support**: Train and assist drivers with our Driver App, troubleshoot and install printers, and provide vehicle management.
* **Corporate \& Onsite Support**: Offer on\-site assistance for corporate clients, support daily operations, and uphold food safety and quality standards.
* **Inventory \& Audits**: Conduct inventory management and daily audits, track materials, and support kitchen and equipment maintenance.
* **Team Development**: Assist with recruiting and training for sorting and driver workforce.
* **Quality Assurance**: Maintain and ensure compliance with quality standards and on\-time delivery (OTD).
* **Additional Tasks**: Perform other responsibilities as assigned to support operational needs.


### **Requirements**


* **Experience**: 2–3 years of delivery platform experience.
* **Professional Skills**: Team\-oriented, responsive, organized, with excellent customer\-facing and communication abilities.
* **Technical Skills**: Proficient in Google Workspace and project management tools.
* **Personality**: Professional, punctual, with an upbeat attitude and continuous improvement mindset.
* **Organization**: Detail\-oriented and consistent in reviewing work before delivery.
* **Language**: Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.
* **With restaurant supervisor experience is a plus.**


### **Equal Opportunity Employer**


WeBox is an equal\-opportunity employer committed to hiring based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

If you meet the requirements and are interested in this position, please submit your application.

jobs.title: Creator & Community Program Lead — Grok Imagine
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**



The Imagine Product team is redefining AI\-driven media experiences for Grok users worldwide. In this role, you'll build the communications system that meets creators where they are: public proof of what Grok Imagine can do, programs that show creators how it makes them faster, more cost\-efficient, or more ambitious, and a community that runs from individual makers to production houses. The job is to move the brand from talking about itself to making other people talk about it — through proof, craft, and community. If you're a hands\-on communicator who can turn product capability into credible stories, repeat advocates, and a feedback loop back into the product, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Own creator and community communications strategy for Grok Imagine — plan and execute outreach that turns product capability into visible proof, creator adoption, and durable brand affinity.
* Build and ship product\-showcase content across owned channels.
* Design and run influencer programs as two distinct motions: awareness partners who put Grok Imagine in front of volume, and craft partners.
* Build relationships with production houses, studios, and in\-house creative teams. Get Grok Imagine into real editorial and post\-production pipelines, and run a two\-way channel so professional workflow feedback reaches the product.
* Manage external production when in\-house capacity is not enough — bidding, contracts, workflow, and quality control — in close partnership with creative leads who set the taste bar for anything that ships under Grok's name.
* Track how competing AI media products talk to creators and professionals. Build the measurement that shows which communications work actually drives adoption, and that can support investment in the work.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**


* Proven experience leading communications, creator partnerships, or community programs for a consumer or creator\-facing product, including shipped showcases, tutorials, case studies, or creator programs that moved people from curiosity to practice.
* Hands\-on operator: you can write a brief, run outreach, ship a content calendar, manage a vendor, and stand up a curation and rights\-clearance pipeline without a large team underneath you.
* Experience working with creators, influencers, or professional media practitioners, and judgment about which voices confer reach versus which confer credibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; you can be precise with internal partners and compelling with external audiences.
* Strong editorial judgment and a clear standard for what can go out under the brand.
* Comfort operating in a small, high\-velocity team alongside product, research, design, and engineering.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**


* Background in AI\-driven media, generative tools, or adjacent creative software.

jobs.title: Training Lead, Safety & Operations
jobs.description:
### **Who we are**



Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle\-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation\-as\-a\-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short\-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world's first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3\-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.



The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom\-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick\-up and drop\-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all\-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.


### **About the role**



The Head of Training establishes, matures, and leads the technical training infrastructure across all operational sites. This role ensures that testing, field deployment, and engineering support teams operate at the highest standards of safety, technical competence, and operational efficiency.



This role is onsite 5 days a week at our Santa Clara, CA office!



### **What you'll do**


* **Program Development \& Maturity:** Build, refine, and standardize training curricula for testing, deployment, and engineering support personnel, aligning content directly with safety benchmarks and operational milestones.
* **Technical Translation \& End\-to\-End Execution:** Take complex technical engineering material and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), translate them into clear, accessible training materials, and execute the resulting training programs end\-to\-end.
* **Critical Procedures \& Processes:** Take responsibility for ensuring the organization is thoroughly trained on all critical procedures and processes, embedding standard operating procedures (SOPs) deeply into daily workflows to maintain strict safety and operational integrity.
* **Administrative Compliance \& Traceability:** Implement rigorous record\-keeping frameworks to monitor, document, and audit all training metrics, ensuring total traceability and audit\-readiness across the organization.
* **Quality Assurance \& Delivery Oversight:** Audit and evaluate field trainers to ensure faithful, standardized execution of training content and rigorous testing methodologies across all facilities.
* **Continuous Elevation \& Real\-Time Monitoring:** Establish dynamic competency matrices to track team capabilities in real\-time, delivering ongoing learning modules to continuously elevate technical skills alongside hardware/software updates.
* **Retraining \& Recertification:** Develop, maintain, and execute structured retraining workflows to address skill gaps, post\-incident remediation, and routine safety recertifications.

### **What we're looking for**


* **Autonomous Systems Experience:** Demonstrated track record leading technical training or operational safety programs within the autonomous vehicle (AV), deployed robotics, or safety\-critical technology sectors.
* **Commercial Trucking Awareness:** Strong technical familiarity or direct experience with autonomous commercial trucking operations, including operational logistics and related safety protocols, is highly preferred.
* **Multi\-Site Leadership:** Proven ability to scale training operations, manage remote trainers, and standardize processes across geographically distributed operational hubs.
* **Administrative Rigor:** Experience utilizing Enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS) and capability tracking platforms with strict data integrity requirements.
* **Willingness to Travel:** Ability to travel frequently to all operational, testing, and deployment locations.


Salary Range \- $180,000\- $260,000


### **More about Gatik**



Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas\-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the *first and only* company to achieve fully driverless middle\-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.



We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology \- an integration of software and hardware \- to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point\-to\-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik's well\-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper\-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate\-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations.



Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Blockit**
-----------------


Blockit is a Sequoia\-backed AI time agent.


It learns your preferences and can autonomously coordinate meetings to any degree of complexity (timezones, group scheduling, IRL, etc) similar to an executive assistant – but never goes to sleep and responds instantly.


Blockit is the foundation of a massive platform of AI agents that will have access to the world's time. The more people who continue to link their calendars to the agent, the more powerful our network becomes.

**Role**
========


Blockit is seeking a Customer Success Manager to lead activation, adoption, and retention across our customer base. We're looking for someone with 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions at a software company. Experience standing up a function rather than inheriting one is a plus.


You will personally work with every contracted account we have — today that's hundreds of accounts, heavily concentrated in venture capital, private equity, financial services, and professional services firms, alongside a fast\-growing base of AI and technology startups. You'll partner with our onboarding specialist to run pilots, fix problems, drive adoption, surface expansion signals for the rest of the GTM team, and be the voice that carries what they tell us back into the product.


Ideally, you are technical enough to figure out SSO or a broken calendar sync before you escalate it, commercially aware enough to recognize when an account is ready to grow, and analytical enough to write an SOP when a customer asks a usage question our dashboard can't answer yet. You are comfortable and excited by the speed of zero\-to\-one building in a startup environment and bonus points if you have a passion for productivity tools.


Our agent spreads virally, which means accounts land on you already curious and already using the product. Your job is to turn that curiosity into activated, deeply adopted teams — and to ensure the motion that lets the next ten people do it after you.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Lead Enterprise onboarding, pilots, and rollouts end to end — setup, admin training, then adoption team by team: usage reviews with admins and chasing the pockets that haven’t linked calendars.
* Serve as the primary contact for inbound support and agent\-behavior feedback via email and Slack.
* Handle churn with a real save motion: understand why, offer the right landing spot, and harvest the reason.
* Build the machine: usage and retention reporting, templates, runbooks, and the QA loop behind our AI support agent.

**What success looks like:**
----------------------------

* **Accounts activate.** Within 90 days of close, most of an account’s users clear the value bar — five or more meetings scheduled. Account activation rate is the number you own.
* **Activation sticks.** Users hold that bar on a trailing 90\-day basis. First\-time activation is the start; sustained usage is the proof a team has actually changed how it schedules.
* **The product gets better.** A third of what customers write to us is a bug, a sixth a feature request. You turn that stream into prioritized input for product and engineering.

**Who you are:**
----------------

* 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions. Founding or first\-CS\-hire experience is a strong plus.
* Technically curious and unafraid of the stack — you can hold your own with engineers.
* Comfortable with data and quick to learn. You know the difference between a number and a story.
* Commercially aware: you’ve read an account, known when it was ready to grow, and made the case with evidence rather than instinct.
* Exceptional writer — most of this job happens in email and Slack, in front of managing partners and heads of platform at some of the best firms in the world.
* Organized to a fault, with high agency and no ego about scope. Fifteen external calls, forty email threads, a bug queue, and a pilot scorecard only coexist if you have a system — and some weeks the job is a training session, some weeks a supplier registration portal at 9pm.
* Bonus: experience with horizontal productivity tools, or a network in venture capital, private equity, or professional services.

jobs.title: Manager 2, Data Science - Intuit Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


The Intuit Customer Success (ICS) Data Science \& Analytics team is seeking an exceptional Manager 2, Data Science to lead measurement of expert\-driven service excellence across our CG expert workforce. You will lead a team of data scientists covering five interlocking areas: expert\-driven conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities (work item management, scheduling, and appointments), training efficacy and expert upskilling strategy, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization across our Team of Experts.

  

Collaborating closely with VEP (Virtual Expert Platform), Expert Network, and Service Design leaders, you will build the measurement backbone needed to see and optimize service excellence end\-to\-end (E2E) at scale for CG — with a particular focus on conversion and customer\-serving time outcomes. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of customer success at Intuit as we build a service platform to empower our customers beyond core product use. This is your opportunity to join this exciting and transformational journey.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the measurement strategy across CG's expert service pillars — expert experiences conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities, training and upskilling, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization — in close partnership with VEP, Expert Network, and Service Design leaders.
* Advance causal inference and experimentation as a shared capability, establishing the causal relationship between service guidance, expert behavior, and outcomes like conversion and customer\-serving time.
* Contribute to a cross\-signal, causal\-graph decision engine that connects expert behavior, quality, and operational signals to size the impact of levers and inform roadmap and investment decisions.
* Build and govern the training and learning platform efficacy framework, connecting L\&D investment to expert quality and business outcomes.
* Partner with cross\-functional business leaders (e.g., VEP, Expert Network, Service Design, Service Delivery, Operations, Learning \& Development, Expert Engagement) to shape strategy, investment priorities, and reporting cadence (e.g., WBR, Redzone).
* Lead and develop a world\-class team of analysts and data scientists, coaching technical and strategic skill sets, especially in advanced analytics, applied data science, and modeling.
* Translate business and analytics strategies into multiple short\-term and long\-term projects, and manage end\-to\-end execution, including the creation of a metric framework for expert experiences and developing learning plans that connect training and service investments to expert experience metrics.
* Activate analytics insights that lead to decisions or better hypotheses, and evangelize innovative analytics ideas that enable new opportunities.
* Drive analytics rigor by inspecting and improving experimentation methodologies and techniques, and creating a learning culture.
* Drive the data roadmap from data quality to data visualization, and construct data models that enable E2E service excellence measurement.
* Role\-model "win\-together" while challenging the status quo and driving change across teams, regardless of organizational structure.

 **Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of diverse analytics and data science experience, including product analytics and customer/expert experience analytics.
* Proven experience leading a team of analysts and/or scientists.
* Strong passion for uncovering strategic opportunities and solving business problems.
* Prior hands\-on experience with advanced statistical analysis, controlled experimentation (including A/B testing of hierarchical mixed effects), and applied data science.
* Prior hands\-on experience with Causal Inference methods (Propensity Score, DiD, Synthetic Control, etc.) and knowing when to use them to answer key business questions.
* Experience designing quality and experience metrics (e.g., NPS\-style scores, quality scorecards) and connecting them to business KPIs such as conversion and service time.
* Proficient with SQL and Python.
* Experience applying AI/ML and GenAI tools to accelerate analysis and workflows.
* Experience with data gap assessments, requirements gathering, and infrastructure implementation.
* Outstanding communication skills with both technical and non\-technical colleagues.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Operations Research, etc.)

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

San Diego $189,000 \- $256,000

jobs.description:
**Job Description**


ACTIVE Network, a Global Payments Company, is seeking a talented **Account Manager** to drive revenue through successful management and growth of their assigned book of business. S/he will manage a high volume of existing clients worth over $7M in revenue by communicating product/services updates, identifying product and client training gaps, ensure the delivery of quality customer and technical services, and resolve attrition issues to renew the client’s business. Account Managers are expected to drive continued market and competitive learning through research and customer outreach, as well as report findings to the team at regular intervals to maintain strong and ever\-evolving market knowledge among entire team.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Drive revenue through minimizing customer attrition and increasing sales to account base.
* Meet and exceed assigned quota targets.
* Quote and sell software and services to existing customer accounts.
* Manage contract renewals for an assigned book of business.
* Develop and maintain a business consultant relationship with client decision\-makers in higher revenue accounts.
* Analyze client business for new opportunities, suggesting relevant products and services, and presenting market\-specific content valuable to client growth.
* Build relationships with contacts across the organization to drive retention and mitigate attrition risk, primarily through regular, proactive contact.

* Identify root causes of client “pain points” and issues.
* Liaise between teams to facilitate resolution of technical issues.

Peer recognition and service anniversary awards, as well as spot performance bonus opportunities

The salary range for this role is $63,000\-$90,000 plus a generous sales incentive program. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may change in the future. Pay within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

jobs.description:

As the world leader in calibration services, Trescal delivers precision measurement solutions across every major industry, geography, and instrument type. Our network of technical experts and accredited laboratories ensures the highest standards of quality, compliance, and performance.


The **Key Account Manager (KAM)** is responsible for maintaining, strengthening, and expanding existing customer relationships within an assigned portfolio of strategic accounts. This role focuses on account retention, organic growth, and long\-term partnership development, ensuring customers receive consistent value, high service levels, and solutions aligned with their operational and regulatory requirements.


The Key Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, working cross\-functionally to identify opportunities for expanded services, improved coverage, and multi\-site or multi\-service agreements—particularly within regulated environments such as Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Aerospace, and Electronics Manufacturing.

**Responsibilities:**

**Account Management \& Retention**

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**Drive daily operational excellence by ensuring smooth patient flow, optimized schedules, and high\-performing site operations that deliver exceptional patient experiences.**



At SimonMed, the Operations Lead is a hands\-on leader responsible for the daily performance of an imaging center. This role ensures efficient workflows, strong patient access, and consistent execution across front office and clinical coordination functions.



Serving as the operational backbone of the site, this leader partners closely with staff, providers, and leadership to resolve issues in real time, improve processes, and maintain compliance with organizational and regulatory standards. If you thrive in fast\-paced environments and enjoy leading through action, this role offers meaningful impact every day.


### **What You Bring**

**Operational leadership mindset:** You confidently guide daily priorities, support staff, and keep the site running smoothly and efficiently.


**Strong analytical and organizational skills:** You review worklists and reports, monitor performance trends, and use data to identify gaps and improve workflows.


**Calm under pressure:** You manage competing operational demands while maintaining focus on patient flow, accuracy, and service quality.


**Detail and compliance focus:** You ensure accuracy in exam status tracking, documentation, payment collection workflows, and adherence to HIPAA and regulatory standards.


**Hands\-on coaching approach:** You provide real\-time support, guidance, and issue resolution while helping staff stay aligned and accountable.


**Continuous improvement mindset:** You identify inefficiencies, recommend solutions, and support process improvements in collaboration with leadership.

### **What You’ll Gain**

**High\-impact leadership role:** Your work directly improves patient flow, access to care, and overall site performance, ensuring patients receive timely, efficient, and compassionate care when they need it most.


**Hands\-on operational experience:** Lead daily execution across scheduling, capacity management, front office operations, and workflow optimization.


**Collaborative environment:** Partner with technologists, front office staff, providers, and leadership teams who are committed to shared success.


**Growth opportunity:** Build expertise in healthcare operations, radiology workflows, and multi\-modality imaging environments.


**Visibility and influence:** Play a key role in identifying operational improvements and helping shape site\-level performance outcomes.

### **You’re a Strong Fit If You Have**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, or related field preferred
* 3\+ years of experience in radiology, imaging, or healthcare operations
* Experience with radiology systems such as EXA, RIS, and EMR preferred
* Prior lead, senior, or informal supervisory experience strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of patient flow, scheduling, and front office operations
* Experience with TOS workflows, insurance coordination, and operational reporting preferred
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced healthcare environment
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Detail\-oriented with strong accountability and follow\-through

### **Benefits**


Your health, happiness and future matters!



At SimonMed, we offer:


* We believe in preventative care for everyone including our team – SimonMed provides free, whole\-body scans to each member
* Competitive wages
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) eligibility
* Pet Insurance
* Paid holidays
* PTO
* Sick Time

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of drug and background screening. Some positions will require a favorable driving record.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Intake Coordinator - In Office
jobs.description:
**This position is 100% in office!!!**

At **Muir Home Health** , we believe that home healthcare is more than just a service – it’s a commitment to enhancing the quality of life of every individual we serve. Nestled in the heart of the vibrant East Bay area of California, we are on a mission to revolutionize the way home health is perceived and delivered.


**Muir Home Health is growing and looking for an experienced and compassionate Scheduling/Intake Coordinator to join our team!** As a scheduling/intake coordinator with Muir Home Health, you will have the opportunity to advance your career while receiving strong compensation and excellent benefits.


**BENEFITS**

* Competitive compensation
* Health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
* 401(k) plan with generous company match
* Critical illness benefit
* Paid time off
* Employee assistance program

**Pay Range:** $24\.00 \- $34\.00/hr


**Job Type:** Full Time


**JOB SUMMARY**

The Intake Coordinator/Scheduler is responsible for managing all aspects of the patient intake and staffing processes to support the operations of the Home Health Agency. This role serves as a central point of coordination, communicating directly with patients, families, referral sources, and internal staff to ensure seamless delivery of services.


Key responsibilities include overseeing patient intake, performing data entry, verifying insurance and obtaining authorizations, and facilitating daily intake stand\-up meetings. The coordinator also manages clinician scheduling and workflow completion in Home Care Home Base, ensuring accurate alignment of patient needs with staff availability.


This position requires building and maintaining positive relationships with patients, families, clinical field staff, contract staff, and referral sources, while proactively responding to inquiries, resolving concerns, and maintaining accurate information to support efficient coordination of patient care services.


**DUTIES AND RESPSONSIBILITY**

* Direct and manage all daily patient referral, intake, and scheduling operations, including oversight of intake policies, procedures, and workflow efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with all state, federal, Medicare, and Joint Commission regulatory requirements related to intake, scheduling, and service delivery.
* Coordinate seamless patient transitions to home care by overseeing patient intake, education, plan of care initiation, and collaboration with multiple service providers.
* Verify insurance coverage, obtain authorizations, and support maximum third\-party reimbursement, including negotiating service pricing within established guidelines.
* Manage clinician scheduling and staffing processes by maintaining accurate data on staff demographics, skill sets, availability, and productivity levels to align patient needs with appropriate resources.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound calls, responding promptly and professionally to patient, staff, and referral source inquiries and concerns.

jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
**People Operations Generalist**
--------------------------------

**About Ent**
-------------


Ent is the intent\-aware workspace security platform for securing human and AI\-driven work. Built to protect productivity, the new attack surface, Ent understands not just what users and agents do but why, and intervenes at the moment of risk before incidents occur. Where existing tools see events, Ent sees intent, so security teams can step in at the moment of risk instead of investigating days later. Founded by Lou Manousos and Brandon Dixon, co\-founders of RiskIQ (acquired by Microsoft) and the team behind Microsoft Security Copilot, Ent is in production with Global 2000 customers across hospitality, financial services, and defense, and backed by Decibel, Sequoia, Crosspoint Capital, Craft Ventures, Shield Capital, Felicis, and In\-Q\-Tel. We’re now hiring the team that will define this category.

**How We Work**
---------------

***Customer first.*** The product and the business are built around problems we’ve watched real security teams struggle with — not the other way around. Every roadmap conversation starts with what a CISO told us last week.

***Humble.*** No drama. We hire people who share the mission and trust each other to deliver. Teamwork over showmanship. Accountability over politics. The work speaks louder than the person doing it.

***Urgency.*** The window to build a durable security company in the AI era is open right now and it will not stay open. The shot clock has started. We move at the speed of the people we want to protect.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are seeking a People Operations Generalist who leads with curiosity and thrives with real independence. People Operations at Ent is a team of one today, and there’s a lot still to build. We own the HR tech stack, the policies, the processes, and the employee experience end to end, across the US, UK, and Canada. Onboarding, offboarding, documentation, and program infrastructure are all being built from the ground up.

**What You’ll Achieve (Responsibilities)**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions across Slack, email, and ticketing, and build the resources that let employees answer more of those questions themselves
* Own onboarding end to end, from pre\-boarding logistics through the first 90 days, and iterate on it every cycle
* Run offboarding, including exit interviews, and turn what you hear into insights leadership can act on
* Support our HRIS (HiBob) as system administrator, including data integrity, workflows, permissions, and reporting
* Support global benefits and perks across the US, UK, and Canada, including open enrollment, vendor relationships, and our Employer of Record partnership
* Keep us compliant across three countries, including I\-9 verifications, employment documentation, and jurisdiction\-specific requirements
* Maintain and champion People policies
* Build and grow our internal resource hub so that self\-service becomes the default, not the exception
* Identify where AI and automation can replace manual work, then build and document those workflows for the team
* Turn one\-off requests into repeatable processes, so the function scales faster than the headcount does

**What You’ll Bring (Requirements)**
------------------------------------

* San Francisco. Onsite, or within commuting distance and in the SF office on a regular (though flexible) basis, e.g. 2 to 3 days a week.
* 2\-4 years of experience in People Operations, HR coordination, or employee programs
* Demonstrated ownership of operational HR workflows such as leave of absence, accommodations, onboarding, or offboarding
* Working knowledge of HR systems (HiBob, SequoiaOS, Checkr, Carta) and comfort learning new tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including employee\-facing documentation and internal HR communications
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple programs, timelines, and stakeholders
* A service\-minded approach and ability to handle sensitive situations with care, discretion, and confidentiality
* Curiosity and a mindset of continuous improvement — always looking for ways to make things simpler, clearer and more scalable!

**Our Benefits**
----------------

* **Distributed workplace.** While we have positions we hire for in our SF office, we also hire remotely across North America.
* **Own a piece of the journey.** Every teammate gets meaningful equity on top of their salary.
* **We’ve got you covered.** Generally, we pay 90% of your medical, dental, and vision is paid by Ent. We also cover 75% for your dependents.
* **Take the time you need.** Our flexible PTO lets you recharge, travel, or just take a breather.
* **Family matters.** 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave (birth, adoption, or foster)!
* **Live well.** A $100 monthly lifestyle account to spend on what keeps you healthy and happy — fitness, wellness, learning, and more.
* **Set up your space.** A $500 home office stipend when you join as a remote employee.

**Diversity \& Accommodations**
-------------------------------


We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize there is no single path to success and value nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.


We strive to ensure an inclusive experience at every stage of hiring and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our process, please let your recruiter know. As an equal opportunity employer, our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you do your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

* RealmOne is seeking a SOCOM Account Manager to serve as the company’s primary customer\-facing growth representative across U.S. Special Operations Command and other priority Department of War accounts. This individual will be the front door for RealmOne’s capabilities; developing trusted customer relationships, identifying mission and technology gaps, and connecting those needs to RealmOne Foundry technologies, research and development, technical capabilities, and delivery expertise.
* The Account Manager will lead early customer engagement and technology insertion activities, mature opportunities before formal solicitations, and transition qualified opportunities into RealmOne’s formal capture process. Success requires credibility with operational and acquisition customers, sufficient technical familiarity to translate mission problems into solution concepts, and the ability to coordinate across Growth, Foundry, Delivery, and external industry partners.

* Own and develop customer relationships across USSOCOM, SOF Components, and priority DoW accounts.

* Identify customer mission needs, operational pain points, capability gaps, and emerging technology requirements.

jobs.description:
**Join Us in Shaping the Future of Clinical Research**



Adams Clinical is a leading clinical trial site network committed to accelerating the development of life\-changing medicines. Our mission is simple: deliver uncompromising data quality, safety, and diverse enrollment to advance healthcare. Our vision is to set the gold standard for clinical trial excellence. We believe our people make the difference. Guided by our core values—*Scientific Rigor, Operational Excellence, Commitment to Sponsors and Participants, and Authentic Collaboration*—we create an environment where meaningful work drives meaningful change.



At Adams Clinical, you'll find:


* A culture of respect, transparency, and continuous improvement
* Opportunities for professional growth and learning
* A team dedicated to improving lives through innovation and integrity


If you're passionate about making an impact in clinical research and want to be part of a collaborative, mission\-driven organization, we'd love to have you on our team.


**Position Overview**



The Senior Enrollment Specialist serves as a strategic leader within the Enrollment department, driving enrollment performance across multiple clinical research sites and studies. This role combines direct enrollment expertise with operational leadership, data\-driven decision\-making, mentorship, and process improvement.



The Senior Enrollment Specialist is responsible for identifying enrollment barriers, optimizing candidate conversion strategies, supporting study launches, and partnering with site and organizational leadership to ensure screening and enrollment goals are achieved. This position acts as a subject matter expert and escalation resource for Enrollment Specialists while helping shape enrollment best practices across the organization.

* Develop recommendations to improve scheduling, screening attendance, retention, and enrollment outcomes.
* Identify risks to enrollment targets and implement corrective action plans.

* Assist leadership in prioritizing studies, sites, and recruitment initiatives.


Cross\-Site Leadership

* Ensure enrollment workflows are standardized and consistently executed across sites.


Operational Excellence \& Process Improvement


* Evaluate enrollment workflows and identify opportunities for efficiency improvements.
* Lead process improvement initiatives to reduce enrollment bottlenecks and improve candidate conversion.
* Develop and maintain enrollment procedures, workflows, and training materials.
* Monitor adherence to SOPs, regulatory requirements, and data quality standards.
* Partner with leadership to implement new technologies, reporting tools, and enrollment processes.


Data Analysis \& Reporting


* Analyze enrollment, conversion, outreach, and screening metrics.
* Create and present performance reports and recommendations to leadership.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and identify trends impacting study success.
* Utilize CRM and clinical trial management systems to support decision\-making.

People Leadership \& Team Management

* Conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings, performance reviews, and goal\-setting discussions.
* Monitor individual and team enrollment metrics, providing feedback and corrective action plans as needed.
* Support hiring, onboarding, training, and retention of Enrollment team members.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the Enrollment team.


Candidate Experience \& Enrollment Support


* Support high\-priority enrollment activities when needed.
* Assist with challenging candidate cases and enrollment escalations.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the enrollment process.
* Maintain compliance with privacy regulations and confidentiality requirements.


**Qualifications**


* Exceptional verbal and written communication, with real skill at building rapport and trust quickly by phone and text.
* Persistence and drive — you follow up, and you do not let a promising candidate go cold.
* Comfort being measured: this role has clear, visible targets and you will own your numbers.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills across many studies, sites, and candidates at once.
* Sound judgment and discretion handling sensitive health information.

### **About the company**


**What’s Promptly in a nutshell**


Promptly is building the first patient\-centered global evidence network, offering real world data sharing and monetization capabilities. Together with a selected network of Partners, we generate new knowledge from harmonized datasets, augmented with the collection of longitudinal patient\-reported data and patient\-generated digital biomarkers within a secure and privacy\-preserving environment.


We answer the question – is this patient treatment the best it could possibly be?

  

  

**What’s our purpose**


We exist to empower every patient and every health organization on the planet with evidence on the outcomes of care!


Why do we get up in the morning? Well, most healthcare professionals have chosen to work in healthcare driven by their desire to make a difference in patients’ lives. And so have we! We have chosen to follow this calling by addressing the biggest problem in healthcare: the lack of real\-world evidence on the outcomes of care.


For us, society denying patients better care due to lack of access to data is unethical, in a world where technology improved so many aspects of our world. Making the right evidence available to healthcare organizations to help prevent one lost life, one care complication, one failed treatment is the moral obligation that big tech companies have – it’s our Hippocratic Oath.
