jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for a driven Project Manager/Delivery Lead to work on the Contact Center Solutions Technology team. This team enables the rest of our associates in Contact Center Operations carry out its mission in serving our patients. A Project Manager/Delivery Lead, is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivery of defined deliverables as part of a larger program and almost always requires engagement from multiple teams. Key responsibilities include communicating the work objectives, coordinating delivery, managing risks, ensuring compliance to standards, and providing end\-to\-end visibility into the health of the deliverables. This role ensures execution and delivery meets or exceeds the client’s expectations in terms of the functionality, quality, timeline, and cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

* You will form teams, kick off projects and coordinate and facilitate routines to support delivery – e.g. status reviews, stakeholder meetings, change controls etc.
* You will shape the final product working with our Business Owners and teams. You will build resilient, supportable technology systems. And as part of that you will make plans and coordinate delivery and dependencies with across multiple teams.
* You will recognize, anticipate, and facilitate dependency management, risk management. You will remove impediments or know who to call and help remove.
* You will actively promote communication and collaboration across organizations to support the deliverable completion and timeline. You will think local (your team) and think global (AEI) and you will manage those two sometimes competing interests.
* You will lead delivery of technical sections of requirements as well as design, traceability matrix, deployment tasks and contingency/rollback plans.
* Software changes are done well but should also be documented well. You understand what "Change Management" means you ensure deliverables comply with Enterprise Change Management standards.
* You will provide status updates for the deliverables to stakeholders and leadership pertaining to delivery, risks/issues, and schedule.
* You will ensure that execution is aligned with deliverable requirements by working with the Business.
* You will support resource planning, manage the resource pipeline, recognize skill deficits, resource bottlenecks and help alleviate them.
* You will be the resource Management, Scrum Master for the Contact Center Solutions Dev team.

**Required Skills**

Bachelor’s Degree with 6 years’ experience in Business Information Services, or Computer Sciences preferred.

* Proven experience in Project Management, Planning, Estimation and Execution.
* Good understanding of Change Management and modern tools used for that purpose \- ServiceNow, JIRA etc.
* Ability to communicate complexity to an audience by tailoring the message.
* You will have an “ownership” mindset and are used to taking collective responsibility for every decision, owning, and managing errors and finding the right way.
* Demonstrate mature judgement in dealing with ambiguity and complexity and can demonstrate balancing enterprise needs over individual program’s
* Ability to handle multiple, competing priorities. There will always be things competing for your mindshare.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to solicit input from others.
* You will be part of a team that lives and breathes Agile and believes in The Manifesto. You understand Agile development and get it like driving on the road. Agile frameworks work alongside cultural values, and you have the cultural background.
* Ability to manage and prioritize the work of others, directly and indirectly working for you.
* Ability to talk to executives and develop presentation material. You understand the BLOT principle \- Bottom Line On Top.
* Persistence, poise, and perseverance to get things accomplished.
* Proven experience in project managing contact center automation and conversational AI initiatives, overseeing cross\-functional teams, enterprise integrations, solution performance monitoring, and continuous optimization to improve customer experience and achieve business outcomes.
* Understands project forecasting and managing project budgets, and PO’s across multiple service providing teams.
* Ability to be hands\-on. Not necessarily write code but you are close enough to technology to be able to guide, discern between competing technical solutions and make choices.
* Very good Excel skills – pivots, charting etc. is often helpful.
* At least 3\-5 years Contact Center experience.
* PMP certification.

Pay: $65\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Clinical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation Specialist**

Account Engagement – I/O Urology Diagnostics Inc (CarePath)

**About I/O Urology**

I/O Urology is dedicated to enhancing the lives of those living with urologic conditions by providing a convenient, accessible, and stress\-free way to monitor their health from the comfort of home. Through our CarePath device, patients gather accurate, reliable data without frequent clinic visits, giving patients and providers immediate access to insights that enhance diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing care.

**Position Summary**

The Clinical Implementation Specialist is the hands\-on partner for clinics adopting the CarePath System. This role ensures that CarePath becomes fully embedded in the clinic’s Lower Urinary Tract Symptom (LUTS) care pathway — that ordering a CarePath Evaluation becomes a routine, reliable step in how the practice works up and manages LUTS patients, and that the resulting reports are consistently retrieved, reviewed, and acted on.

You will work closely with physicians, Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), and clinic operations teams to design, implement, and optimize CarePath workflows — from ordering and receiving CarePath Evaluations to provider review and action planning. This role bridges the clinical and operational sides of healthcare delivery, helping practices efficiently adopt CarePath, improve patient engagement, and deliver better care outcomes through better use of data. Internally, you will collaborate with I/O Urology’s IT, Patient Support, Sales, and Marketing teams to create clarity in the delivery of information through the CarePath Evaluation.

New account onboarding is the center of gravity for this role. Once Sales has established the value of CarePath with the initial ordering providers at an account, you own the transition from interest to routine use CarePath is designed to be simple to implement ; success in this role comes from knowing how a urology clinic operates and being the person every clinic stakeholder—is comfortable working with.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Account Onboarding**

* Own the handoff from Sales at newly signed accounts and drive the account from initial provider interest to routine, self\-sufficient use of CarePath.
* Onboard the account Administrator to establish and configure I/O Urology portal access
* Train ordering staff to place complete CarePath orders and to retrieve and route CarePath Evaluation reports from the portal.
* Work with the practice and its IT resources to build CarePath into the way orders are already placed in the EMR, including order sets, so that ordering CarePath requires no new habit. Understand how the clinic utilizes its systems to share workflow information between providers and staff.
* Confirm that each new account can independently complete the full cycle — order placed, patient supported, report retrieved, report reviewed — before considering onboarding complete.
* Establish a named point of contact at the account and a clear escalation path back into I/O Urology.

**Clinical Adoption \& Workflow Integration**

* Partner with clinics to integrate CarePath seamlessly into their LUTS care pathways.
* Ensure smooth execution of CarePath processes: ordering, receiving, reviewing, and applying evaluation report insights.
* Coordinate with clinic scheduling staff so that patient appointments align with CarePath evaluation timelines and reports are available when the patient is next seen.
* Train staff on what constitutes a complete and valid order from the treating provider, so that evaluations can be performed without avoidable rework or delay.
* Identify and resolve friction in the CarePath workflow — incomplete orders, reports not reaching the ordering provider, portal access gaps — and re\-train as needed.
* Understand the key players within a clinic’s team – those who often drive activity beyond their title – and leverage their help for CarePath integration into the LUTS care pathways.

**Provider Engagement \& Report Education**

* Be comfortable and credible in front of providers: able to walk a physician or APP through a CarePath Evaluation report and the insights the data reveals about their patient.
* Educate providers on interpreting CarePath data and translating it into their own clinical decision\-making. This education is one of the primary drivers of provider confidence in CarePath and of sustained use
* Bring recurring provider questions, points of confusion, and report\-interpretation themes back to the CMO, Marketing, and Product Development so materials, reports, and product can be improved.
* Coordinate closely with Sales, who own the commercial relationship and the case for CarePath. Your role is to make CarePath easy to use and easy to understand — not to sell it.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trust\-based relationships across the clinic
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for CarePath implementation questions at assigned accounts.
* Communicate clearly and adapt to the audience — the same workflow explanation lands differently with a physician, an office manager, and an IT administrator.

**Training \& Ongoing Support**

* Deliver training virtually, using portal walkthroughs and short, role\-specific sessions that fit into a clinic’s day.
* Maintain and improve role\-based training materials and quick\-reference guides for Administrators, ordering staff, and providers.
* Re\-train accounts after staff turnover, as requested, and proactively check in with accounts whose usage patterns suggest a workflow or access problem.
* Support onsite when an account genuinely requires it.

**Internal Collaboration**

* Partner with I/O Urology’s IT team on portal access, integration, and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate as necessary with Patient Support Services to ensure congruity between account and patient engagement.
* Provide Sales with a clear picture of implementation status and readiness at each account.

jobs.description:
At Headlands Research, we are dedicated to enhancing clinical trial delivery within our communities. As a leading network of advanced clinical trial sites, we leverage cutting\-edge technology and exceptional support services to broaden outreach and participation. Founded in 2018, our rapidly growing company currently operates 20\+ sites across the US and Canada, with plans for further expansion.

  



**Location:** Remote \| Site Name: Headlands Research Inc \| Full\-Time \|


**The Company**
===============



At Headlands Research, we are working to improve lives by advancing innovative medical therapies. We are a family of next\-generation clinical trial sites integrating technology and high\-quality support services to make clinical research accessible to participants. Headlands operates clinical research sites across the U.S. and Canada and continues to grow its network and centralized capabilities.

The Participant Recruitment Operations Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day operational performance of the centralized patient recruitment function and recruitment call center. The Manager leads a remote team of patient recruiters and is accountable for call center execution, lead management, pre\-screening productivity, call quality, participant experience, recruiter coaching, funnel forecasting, capacity planning, performance reporting, and consistent operational processes across studies and sites. jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.


This is an opportunity to own the marketing operations function at a high\-growth company. Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations, the Senior Marketing Operations Manager will build the system Stord uses to analyze pipeline: where it comes from, how it converts, where it stalls, and how it tracks against target. You will stay on top of that data week to week and recommend what to change to grow pipeline, then work with Marketing and Sales to make the changes and measure the results.
  

  

Alongside that, you will own the core marketing operations function: administering HubSpot as our marketing automation platform, running lead routing, and building the marketing attribution model that feeds the pipeline analysis.
  

  

This is a hands\-on role. You will work closely with Demand Generation, Events, Content, Customer Marketing, Sales, and the SDR team.
**What You’ll Do**
==================

  

**Pipeline Analysis \& Recommendations**
----------------------------------------

* Build the reporting system Stord uses to analyze pipeline end to end: pipeline created by source and channel, stage conversion rates, velocity, coverage against targets, and where deals stall, with Salesforce as the system of record
* Stay on top of pipeline week to week: know what is moving, what is stalled, and where the numbers are off trend, and flag it before it shows up in a quarterly miss
* Recommend specific changes to improve pipeline (channel mix, campaign targeting, lead scoring, routing, SDR follow\-up, ICP fit) and work with Marketing and Sales leadership to put them in place and measure whether they worked
* Provide the data and analysis behind the weekly pipeline review and the monthly and quarterly GTM reviews, and make sure campaigns and programs are set up to be measured before they launch

**Marketing Attribution \& Reporting**
--------------------------------------

* Build Stord’s marketing attribution model, breaking out pipeline and revenue contribution by channel: demand generation, paid advertising, events, content and brand, partnerships, and SDR outbound
* Own multi\-touch attribution in Salesforce, using Salesforce Campaigns and campaign influence to track marketing\-sourced and marketing\-influenced pipeline from first touch through closed won, with HubSpot as the upstream data source
* Build and maintain marketing performance reporting for executive leadership and the Board of Directors, including pipeline by source, channel ROI, funnel conversion, and spend efficiency
* Manage UTM structure, tracking parameters, and campaign tagging standards in HubSpot so attribution data is consistent across programs and platforms
* Refine the attribution model over time as channels and tools change, and document the methodology so Marketing, Sales, and Finance are working from the same definitions
* Develop and maintain dashboards for weekly, monthly, and quarterly GTM reviews, and support pipeline reporting and forecasting as needed

**Lead Routing \& Funnel Conversion**
-------------------------------------

* Own lead management from capture to opportunity: forms and lead capture, lead scoring, qualification criteria, and routing from HubSpot into Salesforce
* Update and optimize lead routing and assignment rules so inbound leads reach the right SDR or AE quickly, with clear SLAs and speed\-to\-lead targets
* Build routing that is sustainable: documented, testable, and able to hold up as territories, teams, and headcount change without constant manual fixes
* Measure the impact of routing changes on stage conversion rates (lead to MQL, MQL to SQL, SQL to opportunity) and pipeline created, and adjust based on results
* Work with Sales and SDR leadership on lead follow\-up standards, lifecycle stage definitions, and feedback from Sales back to Marketing

**HubSpot Administration**
--------------------------

* Act as the primary HubSpot administrator: workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, segmentation, list management, forms, sequences, and campaign operations
* Own the HubSpot\-to\-Salesforce integration, including field mapping, sync health, and data flow between systems
* Build and maintain marketing automation and nurture programs with the Demand Generation and Customer Marketing teams
* Maintain database health: enrichment, deduplication, suppression, data sta

jobs.title: Operations Manager - DTC eCommerce
jobs.description:
**About the job**

**Company**: Persist Brands

**Job Title:** Operations Manager

**Location**: Remote. We are open to Global candidates

**Employment Type**: Full\-time/ Contract

**Reporting to:** Founder

**About Persist Brands**

Persist Brands is a fast\-growing direct\-to\-consumer eCommerce company that builds and scales aggressive direct\-response consumer brands across categories like apparel, beauty, wellness, and lifestyle. We combine performance marketing, creative testing, data analysis, and operational execution to turn consumer products into scalable offers.

We are a performance\-driven company built around speed, data, creative testing, and operational execution. Our team launches and scales products through paid media, high\-converting funnels, strong creative strategy, customer retention, and disciplined backend operations.

At Persist Brands, we move fast, test aggressively, and optimize constantly. We are looking for ambitious, resourceful, and highly accountable people who want to join a lean, growth\-focused company where their work has a direct impact on revenue, customer experience, and long\-term brand value.

**The Role**

We are seeking a hands\-on Operations Manager – Marketing eCommerce Operations to manage the operational execution supporting our eCommerce marketing and revenue activities.

The role will work closely with Marketing, Media Buying, Creative, Payments, Finance, Customer Support, and Suppliers to ensure products, campaigns, offers, websites, and operational workflows are launch\-ready and perform efficiently.

The ideal candidate combines eCommerce operations knowledge with strong project management, data analysis, and cross\-functional coordination skills and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**What You'll Do:**

**1\. Marketing \& eCommerce Operations**

* Coordinate the operational execution of product launches, promotions, offers, and marketing campaigns.
* Ensure products, pricing, offers, landing pages, tracking, and supporting operational requirements are ready before campaigns go live.
* Coordinate with Marketing and Media Buying teams on campaign requirements, timelines, and operational dependencies.
* Monitor campaign\-related operational issues and ensure timely resolution.

**2\. Product \& Supplier Operations**

* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure product availability, pricing, product information, fulfillment capability, and promotional requirements are aligned with marketing plans.
* Maintain accurate product, supplier, pricing, and operational information across internal systems.
* Identify potential supply, fulfillment, or product issues that could impact marketing campaigns or customer experience.
* Support onboarding and ongoing performance management of suppliers.

**3\. Campaign \& Performance Coordination**

* Track operational KPIs that impact marketing performance, including order volume, cancellations, refunds, fulfillment issues, product availability, and customer complaints.
* Work with Marketing and Finance to identify operational factors affecting CPA, CAC, ROAS, revenue, and contribution margin.
* Provide regular operational insights and reports to the CFO/Founder.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

**4\. Cross\-Functional Operations**

* Act as the operational bridge between Marketing, Payments, Finance, Customer Support, and Suppliers.
* Coordinate timelines, dependencies, and issue resolution across teams.
* Ensure marketing initiatives are operationally feasible before execution.
* Escalate high\-impact issues and delays to the CFO/Founder.

**5\. Process \& Systems Management**

* Build and maintain SOPs for marketing and eCommerce operational workflows.
* Improve processes related to product launches, campaign setup, order flows, supplier coordination, and issue management.
* Maintain accurate operational data across CRM, eCommerce, project management, and reporting systems.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 7–10 years of experience in eCommerce operations, marketing operations, DTC, performance marketing operations, or a related field.
* Experience supporting eCommerce marketing campaigns, product launches, and revenue operations.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between marketing activities and downstream eCommerce operations.
* Experience coordinating with suppliers, fulfillment partners, payment teams, and internal business functions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience working with operational data.
* Strong project management and cross\-functional communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**Deal Breakers:**

* Experience with Shopify or similar eCommerce platforms.
* Experience supporting Meta, Google, TikTok, or other paid acquisition channels from an operational perspective.
* Experience with DTC brands, dropshipping, or performance\-driven eCommerce.
* Familiarity with CRM, analytics, project management, and marketing technology platforms.
* Experience working in a startup or lean eCommerce environment.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, skills, location, internal equity, and other business\-related factors.

Pay: From $3,500\.00 per month

* How many years of DTC eCommerce experience do you have?

jobs.title: Fiber Splicing Project Manager Nationwide
jobs.description:
**About Pacific Tech Communication**

Pacific Tech Communication (PTC) is a growing national telecommunications infrastructure contractor delivering OSP fiber construction, splicing, and related services for Tier 1 and Tier 2 providers. We are hiring a Fiber Splicing Project Manager to own splicing operations from crew assignment through close\-out, billing, and customer delivery.

**Position Summary**

The Fiber Splicing Project Manager plans, schedules, and leads fiber splicing crews and subcontractors across active markets. This is a working leadership role responsible for production, quality, safety, training, customer communication, and accurate billing. Significant travel to job sites and customer markets is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Crew Scheduling \& Resource Management**

* Build and maintain daily, weekly, and look\-ahead crew schedules for in\-house splicers and subcontractors.
* Assign work by skill level, equipment, location, and customer priority; balance multiple concurrent projects.
* Coordinate mobilization, lodging, vehicles, trailers, fusion splicers, OTDRs, and materials so crews arrive ready to produce.
* Adjust schedules for weather, customer change orders, restoration work, and night/weekend cutovers.
* Track headcount, production units, and capacity; flag resource gaps early.

**Training \& Crew Development**

* Onboard new splicers and leads; verify competency on fusion splicing, ribbon fiber, enclosures, testing, and documentation.
* Deliver and document field training on company methods, customer specs, and quality standards.
* Mentor junior splicers; evaluate performance and recommend promotions, coaching, or corrective action.
* Maintain training records and support certification paths (FOA/ETA or equivalent preferred).

**Safety \& Compliance**

* Enforce OSHA, NESC, DOT, and company safety requirements on every job.
* Ensure daily tailgates/JSAs, PPE, traffic control, and confined space/aerial practices are completed and documented.
* Conduct field safety observations and stop work when conditions are unsafe.
* Support incident reporting, near\-miss capture, and corrective actions.

**Billing, Production Tracking \& Close\-Out**

* Capture daily production (splices, enclosures, footage, testing, restoration) against contract units or T\&M.
* Review timesheets, per diem, material tickets, and subcontractor invoices for accuracy before submission.
* Prepare and submit billing packages, as\-builts, OTDR/OLTS results, and customer close\-out documentation on time.
* Resolve billing discrepancies with operations, accounting, and the customer.
* Protect project margin by controlling overtime, rework, idle time, and material waste.

**Customer Relationship \& Communication**

* Serve as the primary field contact for customer construction managers, inspectors, and NOC/restoration teams.
* Provide clear daily/weekly progress updates, forecasts, and issue escalation.
* Walk jobs with the customer; resolve punch\-list and quality items quickly.
* Protect customer relationships during outages, cutovers, and schedule conflicts.
* Coordinate with internal project managers, construction leads, and engineering on prints, splice matrices, and cut sheets.

**Travel \& Field Presence**

* Travel regularly across assigned markets and projects (expected 80%\+ depending on workload), including overnight and multi\-week assignments.
* Be present on critical splices, large cutovers, restorations, and customer ride\-outs.
* Support night work, weekends, and on\-call restoration as project and customer needs require.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to operate or travel with company vehicles required.

**Qualifications**

* 8\+ years hands\-on fiber optic splicing experience (OSP aerial, underground, and/or FTTH).
* 5\+ years supervising splicers, leads, or subcontract splicing crews.
* Proven ability to read splice diagrams, construction prints, and fiber assignment records.
* Working knowledge of fusion splicers, OTDR, power meter/OLTS, and acceptance testing standards.
* Experience with production tracking, unit billing or T\&M billing, and close\-out packages.
* Strong safety record and familiarity with OSHA field requirements.
* Clear written and verbal communication with crews and customers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook) and willingness to use company scheduling/field apps.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; FOA CFOT/CFOS or equivalent a plus.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively; valid U.S. driver’s license; acceptable MVR.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting Tier 1/2 providers (Lumen, AT\&T, Charter, or similar).
* Prior work in multi\-state contractor environments.
* OSHA 10/30, First Aid/CPR.
* Bilingual English/Spanish/Russian a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.
* Opportunity to build and lead splicing operations on national carrier work.
* Direct visibility with operations leadership.
* Benefits details provided during the interview process.

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

License/Certification:

* Driver License (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: Remote

Job Description:

NetImpact Strategies is seeking a ServiceNow Delivery / Project Manager to lead a ServiceNow Platform Operations team supporting a Federal Agency. This role is the single point of management accountability for delivery, staffing, priorities, performance, quality, risk, customer communications, transition, and multi\-vendor coordination. The PM ensures the team can protect operations, meet contractual commitments, and continue planned delivery when incidents, releases, security work, and backlog demand compete for capacity.  

This position requires U.S. citizenship and a post\-award Government background investigation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Serve as the primary management interface for task\-order execution and coordinate Government, prime/subcontractor, and multi\-vendor delivery dependencies without displacing Government decision authority.
* Plan, prioritize, and direct work across platform operations, architecture, engineering, implementation, testing, and business\-analysis lanes so urgent restoration and committed delivery can proceed concurrently.
* Own staffing, onboarding, offboarding, backfill, leave/coverage planning, key\-personnel substitution coordination, background\-processing visibility, and continuity of the full service window.
* Manage demand and capacity in ServiceNow SPM, balancing service/security restoration, committed releases and control deadlines, and the highest\-value prioritized backlog; identify when work is routine FFP execution versus Government\-directed surge.
* Own service\-performance governance, including SLA/KPI/OPI calendars, source\-data quality, dashboards, exceptions/dependencies, corrective actions, and burn\-in validation so reported performance is traceable to operating records.
* Maintain integrated schedules, milestones, sprint/release plans, risks, issues, decisions, actions, dependencies, and deliverables in ServiceNow; ensure weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, and release\-driven reporting is complete and evidence based.
* Coordinate production control, release readiness, architecture/security governance, and cross\-team decisions with the CTA, Platform Operations Lead, product teams, technical monitors, and designated governance bodies.
* Lead incoming and outgoing transition, including transition plans, WBS, access and onboarding readiness, live\-environment validation, artifact/knowledge capture, risk mitigation, and transfer of documentation, scripts, accounts, metrics, and operational knowledge without material interruption.
* Track customer satisfaction, feature adoption, business value, platform maturity, and improvement outcomes; convert approved improvement opportunities into prioritized, owned work.
* Lead major\-service communications and executive escalation, ensuring the Agency receives a clear operating picture, accountable owners, decision points, expected next update, and closure evidence.


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications and Certifications**
----------------------------------------------

* Four or more years of project/program management experience, including leadership of complex technology delivery or operations teams.
* At least three years leading ServiceNow implementations, platform operations, or managed ServiceNow delivery in a multi\-team environment.
* Demonstrated experience with Agile delivery, ServiceNow SPM or equivalent work\-management practices, service\-level performance management, and fixed\-price capacity planning.
* Demonstrated experience managing staffing, transitions, risks/issues/dependencies, release commitments, customer communications, and measurable service outcomes.
* Project\-management certification such as PMP or equivalent required where mandated by the applicable labor category; Agile/Scrum and DevOps credentials are strongly preferred.
* Strong executive communication, prioritization, negotiation, and decision\-management skills.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to satisfy High Risk IT background\-investigation and sensitive\-information requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications and Certifications**
-----------------------------------------------

* Federal consulting or financial\-regulatory experience.
* Experience operating ServiceNow in a multi\-vendor enterprise environment.
* Experience with ServiceNow\-native SLA/KPI dashboards, transition under constrained incumbent overlap, and evidence\-based contract performance reporting.

jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.


Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.


**Job description**
===================


We are looking for a Research Project Manager to join Oura’s Research Operations team, supporting strategic partnership projects generating real\-world evidence of Oura’s impact and utility across health domains and populations. This role will own multiple outcomes\-focused research projects and coordinate closely with Clinical Outcomes, Health Science, Data Science, Engineering, Product, Commercial, Legal, Regulatory, and external partners.We have offices in San Francisco, San Diego and Los Angeles for those who prefer hybrid or office settings. Oura employees in other major cities (like Boston and New York) occasionally gather informally at local co\-working locations.


### **What You Will Do:**


* Own a portfolio of commercial, academic, and member\-based research studies, from feasibility and scoping through partner coordination, launch, data collection, analysis readiness, reporting, and closeout.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic collaborators in academic, healthcare, CRO, and commercial organizations.
* Establish repeatable processes, workflows, and documentation to enable high\-quality research at industry speed and scale in a highly dynamic environment.
* Work with teams of experts to translate research questions into clear study plans, operational requirements, documented decisions, milestones, reporting, and evidence deliverables.
* Coordinate budgets, contracts, partner responsibilities, data\-transfer expectations, privacy and consent requirements, timelines, and issue resolution.
* Monitor study progress, surface risks early, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
* Support evidence dissemination through reports, publications, abstracts, partner deliverables, clinical education, or commercial and regulatory materials as appropriate.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based on the East Coast.


### **What you'll bring**


* 3\+ years of experience managing human research, clinical research, health outcomes, real\-world evidence, healthcare programs, or equivalent partner research programs.
* Experience independently managing external academic, commercial, clinical, CRO, and/or healthcare partnerships.
* Experience taking research or outcomes projects from feasibility and planning through execution, reporting, and closeout.
* Strong project\-management, documentation, risk\-management, and cross\-functional communication skills.
* Familiarity with research data flows, participant privacy and consent, data\-quality review, and tools such as spreadsheets, project trackers, survey platforms, EHRs, EDC, CTMS, eTMF, or comparable systems.

jobs.title: ROI Project Manager (Professional Services)
jobs.description:
As a Project Manager at ROI, you are a key member of the account team(s), dedicated to supporting client success through effective project planning, coordination and execution. You may also provide project management support for internal initiatives that advance ROI’s business priorities and operations.



Our ideal candidate is experienced in driving multiple projects, across multiple accounts, building strong relationships with clients and colleagues, and working in fast\-paced, high\-energy environments. Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills are a must. This role is ideal for people who enjoy creating structure, bringing teams together, and proactively driving work forward to achieve successful outcomes.

* providing end\-to\-end project management across multiple concurrent projects, including developing project plans and timelines, coordinating resources and meetings, managing schedules and hours, tracking deliverables, and partnering with client and internal stakeholders to maintain alignment, manage expectations, and ensure quality, on\-time delivery.
* identifying project risks, issues, dependencies and potential roadblocks and proactively developing solutions.
* establishing clear roles, responsibilities, milestones, and expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
* facilitating project meetings and ensuring decisions, action items and next steps are clearly documented and communicated.
* monitoring project progress and partnering with client and internal stakeholders to maintain alignment, manage expectations, and proactively communicate changes, risks or decisions that may impact scope, timing, budget or delivery.
* coordinating multiple concurrent projects while maintaining attention to detail, quality, and deadlines.
* providing project management support for internal initiatives, including coordinating cross\-functional teams, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
* maintaining accurate project documentation and information in project management and business systems.
* supporting project forecasting, resource planning, and other professional services operational activities.
* conducting project closeouts and identifying lessons learned and opportunities to improve future delivery.
* contributing to the development and continuous improvement of project management processes, tools, and best practices.
### **ROI Competencies**


* **A relationship builder** – Able to build rapport, trust and respect with clients and colleagues at all levels
* **A high performer** – Able to deliver results, every time
* **An expert** – Dedicated to providing the best client experience
* **An owner** – Acts like an owner, driving self and inspiring others
### **Skills \& Abilities**



**Education**

  


Bachelor's degree (four\-year college or technical school) required



Project management certification, such as PMP, CAPM or equivalent preferred

  


**Experience**

  

**4\+ years** managing complex projects from initiation through completion  

**3\+ years** in professional services or client\-facing environment preferred  

Experience working across cross\-functional teams and managing stakeholders at multiple levels



Experience managing multiple concurrent clients and/or internal projects



Experience in event project management and design/creative project management and deliverables a plus.

  


**Technical Skills**

  


Proficient in project management platforms such as **Smartsheet, Asana, Wrike, Monday.com, or equivalent**; collaboration and productivity suites including **Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, OneNote) and/or Google Workspace**; and business communication tools such as **Zoom**. Ability to learn new technology applications quickly.



Demonstrated experience using **AI tools and assistants** (such as **Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini or ChatGPT**) to enhance project management workflows — including drafting and refining communications and deliverables, generating meeting summaries and action items, synthesizing information, and automating routine tasks. Comfortable using **AI\-native features within project management platforms** (e.g., AI\-generated timelines, status reports, or risk flags). Able to evaluate AI output critically, apply sound judgment, and adapt prompts to get accurate, useful results.

  



### **Compensation**


The expected salary range for this role is **$80,000–$110,000 annually**. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills and qualifications.

This position is essential in development of plans and programs for achieving and maintaining quality throughout contract life cycle; monitoring operations to verify adherence to quality plans and requirements; and analysis and investigation of adverse quality trends or conditions. Quality assurance focuses its activities on a team oriented protocol in the identification, prevention, and correction of unsatisfactory conditions or elements which negatively influence resource productivity, safety and customer support.  

  

**Essential Responsibilities:**  

Develop and maintain the health and safety environmental policies and procedures to protect the safety of the public, NASA, Navy and Contractor personnel. Comply with corporate, state, federal and local regulations and contract requirements.\~Deliver and track new employee safety orientations. Develop and deliver training programs in a manner that raises employee awareness and enables employees and supervisors to work safely.\~Participate in the safety committee meetings to bring union and management employees together as a team to address site related safety, health and environmental concerns.\~Coordinate with the Prime Contractor's Safety and Environmental personnel and federal/local government agencies. Provide guidance to managers and supervisors to assist them in the interpretation of and compliance with quality related contract requirements.\~Correspond with insurance loss control experts and claim representatives to strengthen the company worker's compensation and loss prevention program.\~Assist human resources with a credible workers compensation program including developing a strong return to work policy.\~Continuously monitor and evaluate employee exposure to work conditions and make recommendations for accident prevention. Evaluate a changing work environment for hazards and identify means to eliminate and/or control the hazards.\~Maintain safety, health and environmental records. Support issuance of work permits for continued improvements of quality and safety.\~Conduct special evaluations, quality surveys and audits. Compile reports and findings of surveys and audits for company officials for review and make action recommendations as required.\~Conduct accident investigations. Complete and maintain required reporting.\~Maintain current files of all technical documents, instructions, procedures and requirements necessary for implementation of an effective quality assurance program.\~  

  

**Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:**  

Bachelors’ degree in Quality Assurance, Engineering, Business Management or related field and 5 to 8 years of experience or equivalent combination of related training/experience; with at least two (2\) years in a QA/QC capacity and two (2\) years in a management role. Possess excellent written and oral communication and strong organizational, analytical, problem solving, and management skills. Experience with MS office (Excel and Word) and integrated software applications. Detailed\-oriented. Knowledge and application of quality principles and techniques, and the pertinent characteristics associated with Air Force test and training range and critical base mission activities are desirable. Knowledge of statistical methods, ISO 9000 standard, Lean Six Sigma, and other quality methodologies and standards such as (29CRF 1910 and 1926\), NFPA 101, and ANSI. Knowledge of the relationship of quality assurance to other activities such as contract administration, engineering, and supply. Experience conducting studies, investigations, and problem analysis, and developing logical and documented recommendations. Qualify for and maintain a Top\-Secret Security Clearance as required by assigned contract. Possess a valid state issued driver’s license.
  

  

**Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:**  

Typical office environment with no unusual hazards, occasional lifting to 20 pounds, constant sitting while using the computer terminal, constant use of sight abilities while reviewing documents, constant use of speech/hearing abilities for communication, constant mental alertness, must possess planning/organizing skills, and must be able to work under deadlines. Routine travel to contract operational sites is required.
  

  

**Other Responsibilities:**  

  

**Safety** \- Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self\-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams.  

  

**Quality** \- Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities.  

  

**Procedure Compliance** \- Each employee must read, understand and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to his/her job.

$20,000\-$200,000

Sales Account Manager – Insurance Staffing Solutions

**Compensation:** Guaranteed Ramp\-Up Compensation \+ Uncapped Commission  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote / Home\-Based  
**Schedule:** Full\-Time, Monday–Friday  
**Travel:** Up to 25% for trade shows, client meetings, and company events

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced sales professional who already understands the insurance agency business and can build relationships with agency owners at a peer level.

Our ideal candidate has sold successfully to insurance agents, worked in agency distribution, or — preferably — owned or operated an insurance agency themselves. Someone who has personally dealt with recruiting CSRs, service backlogs, producer productivity, staffing costs, retention, quoting workloads, and the challenge of finding good people will immediately understand the problems we solve.

This role is designed for a strong closer who wants to build a meaningful recurring book of business, with guaranteed ramp\-up pay while you build your pipeline and uncapped commission as that book grows.

About Us

We provide specialized remote staffing solutions designed for insurance agencies. We help agencies increase capacity, improve customer service, and allow owners and licensed staff to spend more time selling, retaining customers, and growing their businesses.

Our teams support customer service, administrative work, sales support, appointment setting, retention, and other operational functions. Unlike a traditional staffing company, our people are backed by training, management systems, reporting, workflow tools, call monitoring, quality assurance, and AI\-enabled technology.

What You'll Do

* Develop relationships with insurance agency owners and senior decision\-makers throughout the United States and Canada
* Conduct virtual and in\-person sales presentations and discovery meetings
* Convert company\-generated appointments and marketing leads into new clients
* Understand each agency's staffing model, workflow, growth plans, service challenges, and sales objectives
* Recommend practical staffing solutions based on the agency's actual operational needs
* Build proposals, handle objections, negotiate opportunities, and close new accounts
* Manage and grow a book of business as an ongoing account manager for your clients
* Develop referral relationships and strategic relationships throughout the insurance agency community
* Maintain disciplined follow\-up and manage pipeline activity through the CRM
* Work closely with appointment setters, marketing, operations, and client success
* Attend insurance conferences, carrier events, trade shows, and industry meetings (up to 25% travel)
* Help identify new partnership and distribution opportunities within the insurance market

What We're Looking For

* 3\+ years of successful B2B sales, insurance agency, or insurance\-distribution experience
* Strong understanding of how captive and/or independent insurance agencies operate
* Experience working directly with business owners and senior decision\-makers
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships, develop opportunities, and close new business
* Strong presentation, communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills
* Excellent organization, follow\-up, and pipeline\-management discipline
* Comfort using CRM systems, video meetings, phone, email, and remote\-selling tools
* Ability to work independently and be accountable for production
* Willingness to travel up to 25% for industry events and client meetings

Strongly Preferred

* Former insurance agency owner, principal, or senior agency operator
* Existing relationships with insurance agency owners and decision\-makers
* Experience with captive or independent agency distribution, including major personal\-lines and commercial\-lines carriers
* Experience selling staffing, recruiting, outsourcing, technology, lead generation, marketing, or consulting services to insurance agencies
* Carrier field\-sales, agency\-development, InsurTech, recruiting, or insurance\-services sales experience
* Experience attending or exhibiting at insurance conferences and trade shows
* A demonstrated history of success in a commission\-driven sales environment

Why This Role Is Different

This is not a traditional staffing sales job and it is not a pure cold\-calling position. You'll have support from appointment setters, marketing\-generated opportunities, sales coaching, trade shows, CRM and sales tools, proposal support, and an experienced staffing and delivery organization — plus guaranteed ramp\-up compensation so you're not living purely on commission while you build your book.

We expect our account managers to do more than work company leads. The strongest performers create their own relationships, referrals, partnerships, and market presence. Because commissions are uncapped and grow with the business you develop, this role rewards those who want to build a long\-term book rather than chase one\-time transactions.

Who Will Do Well Here

If you've spent years in the insurance industry and can walk into a conversation with an agency owner already understanding their staffing and operational challenges, this role gives you the opportunity to turn that experience into a high\-value, remote sales career.

Former agency owners are especially attractive to us because you can speak to another owner from experience rather than from a script. If you have industry credibility, strong relationships, and the ability to close, we want to speak with you.

This position is responsible for managed care, insurance verification and patient price estimate processes within the Centralized Managed Care \& Price Estimates (CMC) department. * Collects detailed information of trauma admissions (motor vehicle accident, personal injury, and/or worker’s compensation) to determine accident\-related liability.

* Contact the patient prior to service to inform them of their estimate and collect any pre\-payments at that time.


Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Global Payroll Enablement Associate
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

We are looking for a highly organized, detail\-oriented Global Payroll Enablement Associate to join Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations Enablement team. This role will help keep the team’s enablement engine running day to day by supporting recurring reporting, operational cadences, SOP and documentation hygiene, training content, internal communications, onboarding support, and project follow\-through.

  

As Global Payroll Operations continues to scale, the team needs stronger systems for keeping knowledge current, turning process changes into usable enablement materials, and making sure recurring operational work is completed with consistency and follow\-through. This person will partner closely with the Global Payroll Operations Enablement Lead to maintain the operating rhythm of the team, support frontline readiness, and ensure updates, metrics, documentation, and action items are translated into clear next steps.

  

This is a high\-impact role for someone who enjoys creating structure, building content for internal teams, managing recurring processes, and improving how teams learn, operate, and stay aligned.

 **What you will do**

* Support the Global Payroll Enablement operating rhythm by preparing materials, updating trackers, documenting outcomes, following up on owners, and keeping recurring weekly and monthly workflows moving.
* Help maintain recurring reporting and team updates by gathering inputs, identifying actionable follow\-ups, and turning data or process updates into clear next steps for the team.
* Draft and publish internal enablement communications including newsletters, process updates, launch notes, reminders, and team\-facing summaries.
* Maintain SOP and documentation hygiene by refreshing existing SOPs, standardizing formats, checking links, cleaning up stale materials, and ensuring process documentation stays current as workflows evolve.
* Build and enhance enablement content including training materials, learning paths, onboarding resources, knowledge base articles, and internal guides for new or changing processes.
* Support onboarding and ramp programs by helping improve onboarding materials, training paths, buddy\-program resources, and new\-hire readiness content, while partnering with the Enablement Lead on overall program direction.
* Help facilitate training and enablement sessions by preparing content, coordinating logistics, capturing feedback, and improving materials based on team needs.
* Keep project and process work organized by maintaining clear owners, timelines, next steps, status updates, and follow\-through across enablement initiatives.
* Track key operational and enablement signals by monitoring recurring outputs, surfacing gaps or blockers, and sharing updates with the right stakeholders or channels.
* Support AI and automation readiness by helping keep source content accurate, identifying knowledge gaps, testing outputs, and supporting adoption of AI\-enabled workflows.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Payroll Operations, CX, Product, Engineering, and other teams to gather context, prepare materials, document decisions, and keep action items moving.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2\+ years of professional experience in a fast\-paced environment such as business operations, project management, or management consulting.
* Experience working in a fast\-growth or startup environment is highly desirable. Must have a "roll\-up\-your\-sleeves" attitude and be adept at navigating ambiguity.
* Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational, project coordination, and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to efficiently manage time and prioritize tasks across multiple concurrent projects.
* Experience in global payroll, FinTech, or international launches is a plus but not required.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

  

This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ bonus.

new_jobs.title: Regional Commercial Operations Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

The application window will be open until at least October 5, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Thornton, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience in the energy sector.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience applying AI or other technical tools to automate processes and perform complex analyses.
* Experience with cross\-functional stakeholder management and communication strategy.
* Experience with cost benchmarking and analyzing financial performance for acquisition agreements.
* Experience with executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to drive change management, build awareness, and ensure process adoption across regional teams.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Global Infrastructure and Energy organization is responsible to deliver the infrastructure to host and connect every machine and every user on the internet, with carbon free energy (CFE). As part of the Commercial Operations arm within the Global Operations for Assets and Tooling team, we are responsible to help the strategic negotiators land agreements quickly and be able to maximize our returns.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Analyze and report unit costs associated with network acquisition agreements to inform leadership business strategy and equip negotiators for future discussions.
* Track utilization of approved budgets against contract execution, and prepare the essential data for regular leadership reporting.
* Collaborate closely with regional teams to ensure accurate entry of key agreement terms, project details, and forecasts into required tools, confirming adherence to established processes.
* Liaise with central program manager to implement changes in the region, driving awareness and adoption.
* Apply AI to automate processes and perform complex analyses.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

new_jobs.title: Inventory Control Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.


Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Own the weekly inventory\-accuracy operating rhythm across contract manufacturer and warehouse sites, including cycle\-count performance, adjustment tracking, variance resolution, and key control metrics.
* Manage cycle\-count programs end\-to\-end: count scheduling, ABC classification, variance investigation, reconciliation, and closure.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies across receiving, storage, material movement, and system transactions; lead root\-cause analysis and corrective action plans for recurring errors.
* Review weekly site\-level results, identify performance gaps, and drive timely containment and corrective actions with internal teams and external partners.
* Compare physical inventory to ERP and WMS records, guaranteeing discrepancies are thoroughly recorded and rectified.
* Monitor partner adherence to inventory\-control procedures, transaction rigor, and service\-level expectations.
* Maintain inventory\-control dashboards, scorecards, and SOPs; advance significant risks and unresolved discrepancies with clear impact assessments.

**What we need to see:**

* 8\+ years of experience in inventory control, warehouse operations, or a related supply\-chain function, along with a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Hands\-on experience managing inventory accuracy and cycle\-count programs in warehouse, manufacturing, or distribution environments.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate physical\-to\-system discrepancies and drive issues through reconciliation and closure.
* Experience managing weekly operational metrics, site\-performance reviews, corrective actions, and partner follow\-up.
* Experience working with ERP and WMS platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Manhattan, or similar systems.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel and experience developing operational reports, dashboards, and scorecards.
* Ability to lead cross\-functional problem\-solving and influence internal and external teams without direct authority.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience supporting multi\-site or global service, repair, or warehouse operations with contract manufacturers or 3PLs.
* Advanced skills in SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, or Python for inventory analytics and exception reporting.
* Knowledge of inventory accounting, cost accounting, or audit controls and their working\-capital implications.
* Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous\-improvement methodologies to inventory accuracy problems.
* APICS/ASCM, CPIM, CSCP, or Lean Six Sigma certification.


With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. This role presents an opportunity to have a wide impact at NVIDIA by improving the factory planning function. Are you creative, hard\-working, dedicated, and determined? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you!


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 124,000 USD \- 195,500 USD for Level 4, and 148,000 USD \- 235,750 USD for Level 5\.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.


Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 25, 2026\.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.


NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.


NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_jobs.title: Life Sciences - Reinvention Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
We are:


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

  

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

  

About the role:

* The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
* This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.
* This is not a traditional PMO role — it is an AI\-enabled program manager who uses automation to do what once required a team.

  

The Work:

* Manage project communications, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting across all transformation workstreams — giving the Portfolio Strategy \& Value Lead the visibility needed to govern effectively
* Track budget actuals against plan, surface variances early, and support governance reporting to the client's transformation leadership
* Leverage AI\-powered project management tools and automation to streamline program operations — this role is expected to be a practitioner of the tools deployed
* Coordinate across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators to maintain an integrated view of progress, dependencies, and risks
* Maintain the operating cadence: cadence calls, status reports, risk logs, and action tracking across a fast\-moving transformation engagement

  

You are:


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.


  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:

  

* Program or project management at a top\-tier consulting firm or in a complex enterprise delivery environment, with demonstrated experience managing multi\-workstream programs from initiation through completion.
* A proven track record designing and maintaining program operating rhythms — including cadence calls, status reporting, risk logs, and budget tracking — for senior executive audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered project management and automation tools to improve program visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Strong executive\-ready written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program status into clear, decision\-ready materials.
* Experience coordinating across multidisciplinary teams including consultants, technologists, and change practitioners.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

  

Preferred skills/experience:

  

* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMP, Agile/Scrum (CSM, SAFe), or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience managing AI\-enabled transformation programs or enterprise change initiatives in Life Sciences.
* Familiarity with AI agent orchestration tools for program reporting, status automation, or backlog management.
* Track record at a top\-tier consulting firm managing large\-scale transformation program delivery across multiple simultaneous workstreams.

We anticipate this job posting will be posted until 11/01/2026\.
