new_jobs.title: Staff Program Manager: Customer Success
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Join Intuit as a **Staff** **Program Manager** on the Customer Success team. This is a high\-impact role for someone who enjoys building structure, driving execution, and turning complex ideas into clear, actionable programs.


In this role, you’ll help design and run cross\-functional programs that support our global customer base. You’ll work in ambiguous spaces, partner closely with product, operations, and go\-to\-market teams, and bring order, clarity, and momentum to important initiatives. You’ll be responsible for coordinating work across teams, tracking progress, surfacing risks, and ensuring programs move forward efficiently and deliver meaningful outcomes.

  

This role requires strong operational fundamentals, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once. You’ll regularly present updates and recommendations to stakeholders, collaborate with senior leaders, and help translate strategy into execution.

 **Responsibilities**

**Program Design \& Launch:** Support the design and launch of cross\-functional programs, helping define scope, milestones, ownership, and success metrics aligned to Customer Success and GBSG goals.

**Coordinate \& Execute:** Drive day\-to\-day execution by organizing workstreams, maintaining operating rhythms, and ensuring teams stay aligned, informed, and unblocked.

**Operational Excellence:** Track progress, manage dependencies and risks, and use data to keep programs on track and delivering measurable results for customers.

**Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with product, engineering, marketing, and operations teams to align priorities, clarify expectations, and move work forward.

**Clear Communication:** Deliver concise, relevant updates to stakeholders, clearly outlining status, risks, decisions needed, and next steps.

**Decision Support:** Help identify trade\-offs, prepare recommendations, and escalate issues when needed with clear context and data.

 **Adapt \& Improve:** Anticipate challenges, adjust plans as needed, and continuously improve processes to increase team efficiency and program impact.

 **Qualifications**

* **7\+ years** of experience supporting or leading cross\-functional programs in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Experience working in ambiguous problem spaces and helping bring structure, clarity, and momentum to new initiatives.
* Strong program management fundamentals, including planning, execution tracking, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to use metrics to inform decisions and communicate progress and risks.
* Comfortable managing up and across teams, with experience presenting updates and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate at both the strategic level (understanding goals and priorities) and the tactical level (driving day\-to\-day execution).
* Clear, effective communicator across written and verbal formats.
* Strong collaborator who can influence without authority and build trust across teams.
* Passion for customer success and delivering real, measurable impact.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

San Diego $150,000 \- $203,000

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Requisition ID \# 170610
  
  

**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** San Ramon
  
  

Department Overview
  
  

Engineering, Planning \& Strategy will play a leading role in showing California and the world how PG\&E will meet California’s decarbonization and resilience goals while improving safety, affordability and reliability. The Large Load Project Management Team is responsible for delivering complex, high\-capacity electric infrastructure projects that support major commercial and industrial customers. These projects often involve multi\-phase transmission and distribution upgrades, regulatory compliance, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders to meet customer timelines and strategic commitments.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

This job is represented by Engineers and Scientists of California (ESC) subject to collective bargaining.
  
  

This position, under general direction, exercises judgment and discretion and is responsible for all aspects of the development and implementation of assigned projects and provides a single point of contact for those projects. Project duration is generally multi\-year, requires significant risk management, and may include formal partnering agreements with outside firms. Assignments will have high visibility, require extensive project management skills and often require specific discipline and areas of expertise, such as:
  
  

Electric transmission substation projects
  
Electric transmission line projects
  
  

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need.
  
  

PG\&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to these factors.
  
  

**The salary range is:**  

CA Minimum, $161,520
  
CA Maximum, $207,504
  
  

Job Responsibilities
  
  

Provides leadership, coaching, technical direction, and oversight for assigned projects; also provides knowledge transfer and assistance to many technical and/or project management employees and teams.
  
Proactively controls the scope, schedule, cost, and quality of a large portfolio of projects throughout the project life cycle.
  
Provides extensive knowledge and guidance to others in start\-up testing, inspections, and condition assessment; actively supports complex and/or large project start\-up tests and field inspections.
  
Provides guidance to engineering on producing complex risk and alternative analyses, studies and conceptual designs for presentation to project sponsors and/or leadership.
  
Oversees and administrates EPC contracts.
  
Negotiates third party contracts, in support of other departments when appropriate.
  
Makes presentations to PG\&E Officers as appropriate.
  
Arbitrates and resolves conflicts within the project.
  
Mentors and provides guidance to less experienced project managers.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Minimum:**  

Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) from an accredited college\*
  
8 years of PG\&E (9 years outside) of relevant experience in electric, gas, or power generation operations, engineering, business planning, accounting, finance, construction management, or project management
  
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  
  

* In lieu of a four (4\) year degree, candidates may qualify with twelve (12\) or more years of directly related work experience in areas such as accounting, engineering, construction management, project scheduling, or project controls, with responsibilities comparable to those outlined for this role. External hires must have a minimum of thirteen (13\) years of applicable experience.


**Desired:**  

Electrical Engineering Degree for the Substation projects and Civil Engineering for Transmission line projects
  
Knowledge of and experience with electric substations, and transmission line projects
  
Fluent in the use of Project Management tools and current company tools, such as SAP Financials and Work Management modules and Microsoft Project Scheduling Software
  
Superior ability to interface with and across supporting organizations and conduct formal presentations to officers.
  
Knowledge of land acquisition, CPUC and environmental permitting, and EPC contracting procedures.
  
Demonstrated ability to lead multiple medium to large scale complex projects; provide resolution of complex technical and/or contractual issues; and/or provide Project Management on multiple projects with complex scope requiring non\-standard approaches; without supervision.
  
Demonstrated application of extensive project management skills, including seasoned and experience\-based judgment and organizational business acumen in applying and adapting traditional project management techniques.
  
Demonstrates extensive contracting knowledge and contract negotiation and management skills.
  
Demonstrates excellent verbal and written communication skills, utilizes a variety of styles to connect with the intended audience, and able to present complex information to upper management on a variety of topics.
  
Builds consensus around complex and controversial project \& technical issues.
  
Demonstrated high quality work by self and others on project team.

new_jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.


Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research. As a Project Support Associate, you'll support clinical trials by managing project documentation, coordinating supply chain activities, and ensuring consistent delivery of services. Work closely with internal teams and clients to support study success while maintaining the highest quality standards. You'll handle project planning, documentation management, and cross\-functional coordination to meet timelines and client expectations.

**Position Summary**


The Project Support Associate works with other project managers in a small pod, helping them manage a group of shared projects. The pod shares responsibility for projects and ensures tasks are completed by an appropriately leveled project manager. This position is tactical in nature and responsible for shepherding tasks to completion, resolving issues within internal procedures, and acting as the primary point of contact for low\-complexity client accounts. The team works cross\-functionally to ensure that client requirements and timelines are met. Focusing on building relationships with the client and delivering an excellent customer experience.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provides context and drives consensus internally, serves as a customer advocate. Monitors and bills day\-to\-day project activity. Reports vital issues to team and management.
* Coordinates and assists in setting up and maintaining study filing system, accurately records and captures specifications for each project. Uses digital tools to visualize project landmarks and allow synchronized sharing of knowledge.
* Provides internal/external partners with updates regarding timelines, shipping issues and delays. Coordinates production schedules to work within team capacity and aids in troubleshooting problems. Participates in creation of operations documentation
* Generates, checks and provides required reports to client.
* Timely initiation of all services in accordance with client timelines.
* Backs up the project management team.
* Carries out all tasks in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices.

**Education**


High school diploma is required, a degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.

**Experience**


Position requires 1\-2 years of successful experience in project management as a project coordinator, lab technician or equivalent experience in a customer\-facing environment. In some cases, an equivalency consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

**Basic Minimum Qualifications**


Must be on\-site at our Thermo Fisher Scientific Vacaville, CA location.


Successful candidates will have strong project management skills such as excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to present information and answer questions for clients and management. Will be expected to be able to multitask and coordinate tasks across functional teams while maintaining attention to detail and drive problem solving.


In this team we must be adaptable and able to work in a variety of commercial and custom in\-house software. Proficiency in MS Office Suite is required and knowledge of Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, and TrackWise are advantageous.


Should be intellectually curious and results oriented.


Occasional travel may be required. The physical demands described above are representative of what is needed to complete this work. However, reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to be successful.

**Compensation and Benefits**


The hourly pay range estimated for this position based in California is $23\.04–$34\.56\.
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short\- and long\-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount


For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total\-rewards

new_jobs.title: Data Center Project Manager, US-West CPI, Critical Projects Implementation
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operation data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.  

  

We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.  

  

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think big; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!  

  

A day in the life  

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.
  

  

About the team  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

\#DCCD\_AMER


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of construction or project management experience
* 5\+ years experience managing projects in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure in an operational space. Comparable critical infrastructure experience is defined as a facility that includes a 24/7 emergency backup system, manufacturing facility (semiconductor, auto, medical equipment or Clean rooms), Mass Transportation (freight or passenger rail), Oil and Gas, Utility, Hospitals or similar industry
* 5\+ years in on\-site construction trades (mechanical, electrical, general) Vendor Management

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* 5\+ years experience managing projects in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure in an operational space. Comparable critical infrastructure experience is defined as a facility that includes a 24/7 emergency backup system, manufacturing facility (semiconductor, auto, medical equipment or Clean rooms), Mass Transportation (freight or passenger rail), Oil and Gas, Utility, Hospitals or similar industry
* 5\+ years

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Blockit**
-----------------


Blockit is a Sequoia\-backed AI time agent.


It learns your preferences and can autonomously coordinate meetings to any degree of complexity (timezones, group scheduling, IRL, etc) similar to an executive assistant – but never goes to sleep and responds instantly.


Blockit is the foundation of a massive platform of AI agents that will have access to the world's time. The more people who continue to link their calendars to the agent, the more powerful our network becomes.

**Role**
========


Blockit is seeking a Customer Success Manager to lead activation, adoption, and retention across our customer base. We're looking for someone with 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions at a software company. Experience standing up a function rather than inheriting one is a plus.


You will personally work with every contracted account we have — today that's hundreds of accounts, heavily concentrated in venture capital, private equity, financial services, and professional services firms, alongside a fast\-growing base of AI and technology startups. You'll partner with our onboarding specialist to run pilots, fix problems, drive adoption, surface expansion signals for the rest of the GTM team, and be the voice that carries what they tell us back into the product.


Ideally, you are technical enough to figure out SSO or a broken calendar sync before you escalate it, commercially aware enough to recognize when an account is ready to grow, and analytical enough to write an SOP when a customer asks a usage question our dashboard can't answer yet. You are comfortable and excited by the speed of zero\-to\-one building in a startup environment and bonus points if you have a passion for productivity tools.


Our agent spreads virally, which means accounts land on you already curious and already using the product. Your job is to turn that curiosity into activated, deeply adopted teams — and to ensure the motion that lets the next ten people do it after you.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Lead Enterprise onboarding, pilots, and rollouts end to end — setup, admin training, then adoption team by team: usage reviews with admins and chasing the pockets that haven’t linked calendars.
* Serve as the primary contact for inbound support and agent\-behavior feedback via email and Slack.
* Handle churn with a real save motion: understand why, offer the right landing spot, and harvest the reason.
* Build the machine: usage and retention reporting, templates, runbooks, and the QA loop behind our AI support agent.

**What success looks like:**
----------------------------

* **Accounts activate.** Within 90 days of close, most of an account’s users clear the value bar — five or more meetings scheduled. Account activation rate is the number you own.
* **Activation sticks.** Users hold that bar on a trailing 90\-day basis. First\-time activation is the start; sustained usage is the proof a team has actually changed how it schedules.
* **The product gets better.** A third of what customers write to us is a bug, a sixth a feature request. You turn that stream into prioritized input for product and engineering.

**Who you are:**
----------------

* 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions. Founding or first\-CS\-hire experience is a strong plus.
* Technically curious and unafraid of the stack — you can hold your own with engineers.
* Comfortable with data and quick to learn. You know the difference between a number and a story.
* Commercially aware: you’ve read an account, known when it was ready to grow, and made the case with evidence rather than instinct.
* Exceptional writer — most of this job happens in email and Slack, in front of managing partners and heads of platform at some of the best firms in the world.
* Organized to a fault, with high agency and no ego about scope. Fifteen external calls, forty email threads, a bug queue, and a pilot scorecard only coexist if you have a system — and some weeks the job is a training session, some weeks a supplier registration portal at 9pm.
* Bonus: experience with horizontal productivity tools, or a network in venture capital, private equity, or professional services.

new_jobs.title: Manager 2, Data Science - Intuit Customer Success
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


The Intuit Customer Success (ICS) Data Science \& Analytics team is seeking an exceptional Manager 2, Data Science to lead measurement of expert\-driven service excellence across our CG expert workforce. You will lead a team of data scientists covering five interlocking areas: expert\-driven conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities (work item management, scheduling, and appointments), training efficacy and expert upskilling strategy, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization across our Team of Experts.

  

Collaborating closely with VEP (Virtual Expert Platform), Expert Network, and Service Design leaders, you will build the measurement backbone needed to see and optimize service excellence end\-to\-end (E2E) at scale for CG — with a particular focus on conversion and customer\-serving time outcomes. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of customer success at Intuit as we build a service platform to empower our customers beyond core product use. This is your opportunity to join this exciting and transformational journey.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the measurement strategy across CG's expert service pillars — expert experiences conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities, training and upskilling, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization — in close partnership with VEP, Expert Network, and Service Design leaders.
* Advance causal inference and experimentation as a shared capability, establishing the causal relationship between service guidance, expert behavior, and outcomes like conversion and customer\-serving time.
* Contribute to a cross\-signal, causal\-graph decision engine that connects expert behavior, quality, and operational signals to size the impact of levers and inform roadmap and investment decisions.
* Build and govern the training and learning platform efficacy framework, connecting L\&D investment to expert quality and business outcomes.
* Partner with cross\-functional business leaders (e.g., VEP, Expert Network, Service Design, Service Delivery, Operations, Learning \& Development, Expert Engagement) to shape strategy, investment priorities, and reporting cadence (e.g., WBR, Redzone).
* Lead and develop a world\-class team of analysts and data scientists, coaching technical and strategic skill sets, especially in advanced analytics, applied data science, and modeling.
* Translate business and analytics strategies into multiple short\-term and long\-term projects, and manage end\-to\-end execution, including the creation of a metric framework for expert experiences and developing learning plans that connect training and service investments to expert experience metrics.
* Activate analytics insights that lead to decisions or better hypotheses, and evangelize innovative analytics ideas that enable new opportunities.
* Drive analytics rigor by inspecting and improving experimentation methodologies and techniques, and creating a learning culture.
* Drive the data roadmap from data quality to data visualization, and construct data models that enable E2E service excellence measurement.
* Role\-model "win\-together" while challenging the status quo and driving change across teams, regardless of organizational structure.

 **Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of diverse analytics and data science experience, including product analytics and customer/expert experience analytics.
* Proven experience leading a team of analysts and/or scientists.
* Strong passion for uncovering strategic opportunities and solving business problems.
* Prior hands\-on experience with advanced statistical analysis, controlled experimentation (including A/B testing of hierarchical mixed effects), and applied data science.
* Prior hands\-on experience with Causal Inference methods (Propensity Score, DiD, Synthetic Control, etc.) and knowing when to use them to answer key business questions.
* Experience designing quality and experience metrics (e.g., NPS\-style scores, quality scorecards) and connecting them to business KPIs such as conversion and service time.
* Proficient with SQL and Python.
* Experience applying AI/ML and GenAI tools to accelerate analysis and workflows.
* Experience with data gap assessments, requirements gathering, and infrastructure implementation.
* Outstanding communication skills with both technical and non\-technical colleagues.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Operations Research, etc.)

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

San Diego $189,000 \- $256,000

new_jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
new_jobs.description:
**People Operations Generalist**
--------------------------------

**About Ent**
-------------


Ent is the intent\-aware workspace security platform for securing human and AI\-driven work. Built to protect productivity, the new attack surface, Ent understands not just what users and agents do but why, and intervenes at the moment of risk before incidents occur. Where existing tools see events, Ent sees intent, so security teams can step in at the moment of risk instead of investigating days later. Founded by Lou Manousos and Brandon Dixon, co\-founders of RiskIQ (acquired by Microsoft) and the team behind Microsoft Security Copilot, Ent is in production with Global 2000 customers across hospitality, financial services, and defense, and backed by Decibel, Sequoia, Crosspoint Capital, Craft Ventures, Shield Capital, Felicis, and In\-Q\-Tel. We’re now hiring the team that will define this category.

**How We Work**
---------------

***Customer first.*** The product and the business are built around problems we’ve watched real security teams struggle with — not the other way around. Every roadmap conversation starts with what a CISO told us last week.

***Humble.*** No drama. We hire people who share the mission and trust each other to deliver. Teamwork over showmanship. Accountability over politics. The work speaks louder than the person doing it.

***Urgency.*** The window to build a durable security company in the AI era is open right now and it will not stay open. The shot clock has started. We move at the speed of the people we want to protect.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are seeking a People Operations Generalist who leads with curiosity and thrives with real independence. People Operations at Ent is a team of one today, and there’s a lot still to build. We own the HR tech stack, the policies, the processes, and the employee experience end to end, across the US, UK, and Canada. Onboarding, offboarding, documentation, and program infrastructure are all being built from the ground up.

**What You’ll Achieve (Responsibilities)**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions across Slack, email, and ticketing, and build the resources that let employees answer more of those questions themselves
* Own onboarding end to end, from pre\-boarding logistics through the first 90 days, and iterate on it every cycle
* Run offboarding, including exit interviews, and turn what you hear into insights leadership can act on
* Support our HRIS (HiBob) as system administrator, including data integrity, workflows, permissions, and reporting
* Support global benefits and perks across the US, UK, and Canada, including open enrollment, vendor relationships, and our Employer of Record partnership
* Keep us compliant across three countries, including I\-9 verifications, employment documentation, and jurisdiction\-specific requirements
* Maintain and champion People policies
* Build and grow our internal resource hub so that self\-service becomes the default, not the exception
* Identify where AI and automation can replace manual work, then build and document those workflows for the team
* Turn one\-off requests into repeatable processes, so the function scales faster than the headcount does

**What You’ll Bring (Requirements)**
------------------------------------

* San Francisco. Onsite, or within commuting distance and in the SF office on a regular (though flexible) basis, e.g. 2 to 3 days a week.
* 2\-4 years of experience in People Operations, HR coordination, or employee programs
* Demonstrated ownership of operational HR workflows such as leave of absence, accommodations, onboarding, or offboarding
* Working knowledge of HR systems (HiBob, SequoiaOS, Checkr, Carta) and comfort learning new tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including employee\-facing documentation and internal HR communications
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple programs, timelines, and stakeholders
* A service\-minded approach and ability to handle sensitive situations with care, discretion, and confidentiality
* Curiosity and a mindset of continuous improvement — always looking for ways to make things simpler, clearer and more scalable!

**Our Benefits**
----------------

* **Distributed workplace.** While we have positions we hire for in our SF office, we also hire remotely across North America.
* **Own a piece of the journey.** Every teammate gets meaningful equity on top of their salary.
* **We’ve got you covered.** Generally, we pay 90% of your medical, dental, and vision is paid by Ent. We also cover 75% for your dependents.
* **Take the time you need.** Our flexible PTO lets you recharge, travel, or just take a breather.
* **Family matters.** 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave (birth, adoption, or foster)!
* **Live well.** A $100 monthly lifestyle account to spend on what keeps you healthy and happy — fitness, wellness, learning, and more.
* **Set up your space.** A $500 home office stipend when you join as a remote employee.

**Diversity \& Accommodations**
-------------------------------


We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize there is no single path to success and value nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.


We strive to ensure an inclusive experience at every stage of hiring and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our process, please let your recruiter know. As an equal opportunity employer, our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you do your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

new_jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation Specialist**

Account Engagement – I/O Urology Diagnostics Inc (CarePath)

**About I/O Urology**

I/O Urology is dedicated to enhancing the lives of those living with urologic conditions by providing a convenient, accessible, and stress\-free way to monitor their health from the comfort of home. Through our CarePath device, patients gather accurate, reliable data without frequent clinic visits, giving patients and providers immediate access to insights that enhance diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing care.

**Position Summary**

The Clinical Implementation Specialist is the hands\-on partner for clinics adopting the CarePath System. This role ensures that CarePath becomes fully embedded in the clinic’s Lower Urinary Tract Symptom (LUTS) care pathway — that ordering a CarePath Evaluation becomes a routine, reliable step in how the practice works up and manages LUTS patients, and that the resulting reports are consistently retrieved, reviewed, and acted on.

You will work closely with physicians, Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), and clinic operations teams to design, implement, and optimize CarePath workflows — from ordering and receiving CarePath Evaluations to provider review and action planning. This role bridges the clinical and operational sides of healthcare delivery, helping practices efficiently adopt CarePath, improve patient engagement, and deliver better care outcomes through better use of data. Internally, you will collaborate with I/O Urology’s IT, Patient Support, Sales, and Marketing teams to create clarity in the delivery of information through the CarePath Evaluation.

New account onboarding is the center of gravity for this role. Once Sales has established the value of CarePath with the initial ordering providers at an account, you own the transition from interest to routine use CarePath is designed to be simple to implement ; success in this role comes from knowing how a urology clinic operates and being the person every clinic stakeholder—is comfortable working with.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Account Onboarding**

* Own the handoff from Sales at newly signed accounts and drive the account from initial provider interest to routine, self\-sufficient use of CarePath.
* Onboard the account Administrator to establish and configure I/O Urology portal access
* Train ordering staff to place complete CarePath orders and to retrieve and route CarePath Evaluation reports from the portal.
* Work with the practice and its IT resources to build CarePath into the way orders are already placed in the EMR, including order sets, so that ordering CarePath requires no new habit. Understand how the clinic utilizes its systems to share workflow information between providers and staff.
* Confirm that each new account can independently complete the full cycle — order placed, patient supported, report retrieved, report reviewed — before considering onboarding complete.
* Establish a named point of contact at the account and a clear escalation path back into I/O Urology.

**Clinical Adoption \& Workflow Integration**

* Partner with clinics to integrate CarePath seamlessly into their LUTS care pathways.
* Ensure smooth execution of CarePath processes: ordering, receiving, reviewing, and applying evaluation report insights.
* Coordinate with clinic scheduling staff so that patient appointments align with CarePath evaluation timelines and reports are available when the patient is next seen.
* Train staff on what constitutes a complete and valid order from the treating provider, so that evaluations can be performed without avoidable rework or delay.
* Identify and resolve friction in the CarePath workflow — incomplete orders, reports not reaching the ordering provider, portal access gaps — and re\-train as needed.
* Understand the key players within a clinic’s team – those who often drive activity beyond their title – and leverage their help for CarePath integration into the LUTS care pathways.

**Provider Engagement \& Report Education**

* Be comfortable and credible in front of providers: able to walk a physician or APP through a CarePath Evaluation report and the insights the data reveals about their patient.
* Educate providers on interpreting CarePath data and translating it into their own clinical decision\-making. This education is one of the primary drivers of provider confidence in CarePath and of sustained use
* Bring recurring provider questions, points of confusion, and report\-interpretation themes back to the CMO, Marketing, and Product Development so materials, reports, and product can be improved.
* Coordinate closely with Sales, who own the commercial relationship and the case for CarePath. Your role is to make CarePath easy to use and easy to understand — not to sell it.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trust\-based relationships across the clinic
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for CarePath implementation questions at assigned accounts.
* Communicate clearly and adapt to the audience — the same workflow explanation lands differently with a physician, an office manager, and an IT administrator.

**Training \& Ongoing Support**

* Deliver training virtually, using portal walkthroughs and short, role\-specific sessions that fit into a clinic’s day.
* Maintain and improve role\-based training materials and quick\-reference guides for Administrators, ordering staff, and providers.
* Re\-train accounts after staff turnover, as requested, and proactively check in with accounts whose usage patterns suggest a workflow or access problem.
* Support onsite when an account genuinely requires it.

**Internal Collaboration**

* Partner with I/O Urology’s IT team on portal access, integration, and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate as necessary with Patient Support Services to ensure congruity between account and patient engagement.
* Provide Sales with a clear picture of implementation status and readiness at each account.

Sales Account Manager – Insurance Staffing Solutions

**Compensation:** Guaranteed Ramp\-Up Compensation \+ Uncapped Commission  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote / Home\-Based  
**Schedule:** Full\-Time, Monday–Friday  
**Travel:** Up to 25% for trade shows, client meetings, and company events

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced sales professional who already understands the insurance agency business and can build relationships with agency owners at a peer level.

Our ideal candidate has sold successfully to insurance agents, worked in agency distribution, or — preferably — owned or operated an insurance agency themselves. Someone who has personally dealt with recruiting CSRs, service backlogs, producer productivity, staffing costs, retention, quoting workloads, and the challenge of finding good people will immediately understand the problems we solve.

This role is designed for a strong closer who wants to build a meaningful recurring book of business, with guaranteed ramp\-up pay while you build your pipeline and uncapped commission as that book grows.

About Us

We provide specialized remote staffing solutions designed for insurance agencies. We help agencies increase capacity, improve customer service, and allow owners and licensed staff to spend more time selling, retaining customers, and growing their businesses.

Our teams support customer service, administrative work, sales support, appointment setting, retention, and other operational functions. Unlike a traditional staffing company, our people are backed by training, management systems, reporting, workflow tools, call monitoring, quality assurance, and AI\-enabled technology.

What You'll Do

* Develop relationships with insurance agency owners and senior decision\-makers throughout the United States and Canada
* Conduct virtual and in\-person sales presentations and discovery meetings
* Convert company\-generated appointments and marketing leads into new clients
* Understand each agency's staffing model, workflow, growth plans, service challenges, and sales objectives
* Recommend practical staffing solutions based on the agency's actual operational needs
* Build proposals, handle objections, negotiate opportunities, and close new accounts
* Manage and grow a book of business as an ongoing account manager for your clients
* Develop referral relationships and strategic relationships throughout the insurance agency community
* Maintain disciplined follow\-up and manage pipeline activity through the CRM
* Work closely with appointment setters, marketing, operations, and client success
* Attend insurance conferences, carrier events, trade shows, and industry meetings (up to 25% travel)
* Help identify new partnership and distribution opportunities within the insurance market

What We're Looking For

* 3\+ years of successful B2B sales, insurance agency, or insurance\-distribution experience
* Strong understanding of how captive and/or independent insurance agencies operate
* Experience working directly with business owners and senior decision\-makers
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships, develop opportunities, and close new business
* Strong presentation, communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills
* Excellent organization, follow\-up, and pipeline\-management discipline
* Comfort using CRM systems, video meetings, phone, email, and remote\-selling tools
* Ability to work independently and be accountable for production
* Willingness to travel up to 25% for industry events and client meetings

Strongly Preferred

* Former insurance agency owner, principal, or senior agency operator
* Existing relationships with insurance agency owners and decision\-makers
* Experience with captive or independent agency distribution, including major personal\-lines and commercial\-lines carriers
* Experience selling staffing, recruiting, outsourcing, technology, lead generation, marketing, or consulting services to insurance agencies
* Carrier field\-sales, agency\-development, InsurTech, recruiting, or insurance\-services sales experience
* Experience attending or exhibiting at insurance conferences and trade shows
* A demonstrated history of success in a commission\-driven sales environment

Why This Role Is Different

This is not a traditional staffing sales job and it is not a pure cold\-calling position. You'll have support from appointment setters, marketing\-generated opportunities, sales coaching, trade shows, CRM and sales tools, proposal support, and an experienced staffing and delivery organization — plus guaranteed ramp\-up compensation so you're not living purely on commission while you build your book.

We expect our account managers to do more than work company leads. The strongest performers create their own relationships, referrals, partnerships, and market presence. Because commissions are uncapped and grow with the business you develop, this role rewards those who want to build a long\-term book rather than chase one\-time transactions.

Who Will Do Well Here

If you've spent years in the insurance industry and can walk into a conversation with an agency owner already understanding their staffing and operational challenges, this role gives you the opportunity to turn that experience into a high\-value, remote sales career.

Former agency owners are especially attractive to us because you can speak to another owner from experience rather than from a script. If you have industry credibility, strong relationships, and the ability to close, we want to speak with you.

Work Location: Remote

* **Escalations \& Resolution:** Act as the senior escalation point for platform technical emergencies, contract renewals, and at\-risk client relationships.

What You Bring

* **8\+ years** of hands\-on marketplace or e\-commerce channel management experience.
* **Expert, current platform mastery** of both Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central (hands\-on execution is required).
* Demonstrated experience **managing people who manage accounts** (coaching on strategy, prioritization, and execution).
* A proven track record of **building organization\-wide assets** (SOPs, playbooks, training curricula, or frameworks) that outlast your tenure.
* **Executive presence** with a history of leading high\-stakes negotiations, renewals, and client relationship repairs.
* Multi\-marketplace fluency (Amazon, Walmart, Target Plus) and advanced quantitative/forecasting capabilities.

new_jobs.title: Global Payroll Enablement Associate
new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

We are looking for a highly organized, detail\-oriented Global Payroll Enablement Associate to join Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations Enablement team. This role will help keep the team’s enablement engine running day to day by supporting recurring reporting, operational cadences, SOP and documentation hygiene, training content, internal communications, onboarding support, and project follow\-through.

  

As Global Payroll Operations continues to scale, the team needs stronger systems for keeping knowledge current, turning process changes into usable enablement materials, and making sure recurring operational work is completed with consistency and follow\-through. This person will partner closely with the Global Payroll Operations Enablement Lead to maintain the operating rhythm of the team, support frontline readiness, and ensure updates, metrics, documentation, and action items are translated into clear next steps.

  

This is a high\-impact role for someone who enjoys creating structure, building content for internal teams, managing recurring processes, and improving how teams learn, operate, and stay aligned.

 **What you will do**

* Support the Global Payroll Enablement operating rhythm by preparing materials, updating trackers, documenting outcomes, following up on owners, and keeping recurring weekly and monthly workflows moving.
* Help maintain recurring reporting and team updates by gathering inputs, identifying actionable follow\-ups, and turning data or process updates into clear next steps for the team.
* Draft and publish internal enablement communications including newsletters, process updates, launch notes, reminders, and team\-facing summaries.
* Maintain SOP and documentation hygiene by refreshing existing SOPs, standardizing formats, checking links, cleaning up stale materials, and ensuring process documentation stays current as workflows evolve.
* Build and enhance enablement content including training materials, learning paths, onboarding resources, knowledge base articles, and internal guides for new or changing processes.
* Support onboarding and ramp programs by helping improve onboarding materials, training paths, buddy\-program resources, and new\-hire readiness content, while partnering with the Enablement Lead on overall program direction.
* Help facilitate training and enablement sessions by preparing content, coordinating logistics, capturing feedback, and improving materials based on team needs.
* Keep project and process work organized by maintaining clear owners, timelines, next steps, status updates, and follow\-through across enablement initiatives.
* Track key operational and enablement signals by monitoring recurring outputs, surfacing gaps or blockers, and sharing updates with the right stakeholders or channels.
* Support AI and automation readiness by helping keep source content accurate, identifying knowledge gaps, testing outputs, and supporting adoption of AI\-enabled workflows.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Payroll Operations, CX, Product, Engineering, and other teams to gather context, prepare materials, document decisions, and keep action items moving.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2\+ years of professional experience in a fast\-paced environment such as business operations, project management, or management consulting.
* Experience working in a fast\-growth or startup environment is highly desirable. Must have a "roll\-up\-your\-sleeves" attitude and be adept at navigating ambiguity.
* Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational, project coordination, and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to efficiently manage time and prioritize tasks across multiple concurrent projects.
* Experience in global payroll, FinTech, or international launches is a plus but not required.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

  

This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ bonus.

Synergy Business Innovation \& Solutions is a premier implementer of cutting\-edge software solutions. Synergy brings the experience and expertise necessary to deliver capability that provides tangible ROI to our customers. Synergy offers its employees a generous portfolio of core and voluntary benefits including: group medical, dental, and vision insurance, company paid life, short\-term, and long\-term disability insurance, HSA, FSA, 401(k) with company match, PTO \& Bonus Leave, 11 paid federal holidays, parental leave, tuition and training reimbursement, a referral bonus program, and well\-being programs.


At Synergy, you’ll be challenged and given the opportunity to grow in your career path. In fact, growth is such a big deal to us that we have career mentors available for every employee, company\-funded certification opportunities, education reimbursement, and a general open\-door policy so that you have support when you need it. **About the Role:**


Synergy is seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst to support technical documentation, requirements gathering and delivery, across the Program Management Office (PMO). Additionally, this person will have the opportunity to provide support and analysis across the entire Portfolio.


Looking for someone to deliver technical artifacts, to support program management efforts, and support mission critical systems. Ideal candidate has a proven track record of supporting PMO delivery, in a highly complex software development environment.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead the development and maintenance of technical documentation across the PMO.
* Translate business, operational, and technical needs into well\-structured Jira epics, features, user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting a federal government technology program, PMO, or ERP effort.
* Familiarity developing reports or dashboards.

* Experience using approved generative AI or Microsoft Copilot capabilities to accelerate drafting, visualization, analysis, and briefing development.

**Education Requirements:**

* Required: Bachelors degree in a relevant field.

**Citizenship \& Clearance Requirements:**

* Required: US citizen with Public Trust.
